data.title: Junior Full Stack Engineer, Merchant Tools
data.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Full Stack Engineer, Merchant Tools to help build and improve the applications that Bask Health customers use to manage their telehealth businesses.

Our merchant platform brings together storefront configuration, product management, subscriptions, and business operations. You'll contribute to the tools that help merchants set up their businesses, manage their offerings, and complete everyday tasks.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone early in their career who enjoys building web applications and wants to develop their skills across frontend and backend development.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver features, improve existing workflows, and solve real customer problems.

We're looking for someone who is curious, detail-oriented, willing to learn, and excited to build practical software that makes complex processes easier for users.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve features across Bask's merchant-facing applications.
  • Develop frontend interfaces using JavaScript, TypeScript, and React.
  • Contribute to merchant applications built with Next.js.
  • Help implement backend functionality using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Build and integrate APIs connecting merchant interfaces with backend services.
  • Assist with developing merchant dashboards and business management tools.
  • Contribute to storefront setup and configuration experiences.
  • Help build features for managing product catalogs and product settings.
  • Support subscription management and commerce-related workflows.
  • Develop reusable UI components for merchant-facing applications.
  • Work with SQL databases to retrieve and manage merchant application data.
  • Collaborate with product managers and designers to understand merchant needs.
  • Translate product requirements and designs into working features.
  • Help improve merchant onboarding and account setup workflows.
  • Implement responsive layouts and accessible interface components.
  • Assist with integrations between merchant tools and existing Bask services.
  • Investigate and resolve bugs across frontend and backend functionality.
  • Improve application usability, responsiveness, and performance.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to automated tests.
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from experienced engineers.
  • Learn best practices for application security and merchant data protection.
  • Help document technical changes and implementation details.
  • Contribute to engineering discussions and feature planning.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools while understanding and validating generated code.
  • Take increasing ownership of assigned features as your skills develop.

Requirements

  • Foundational software engineering experience through coursework, internships, personal projects, freelance work, or professional roles.
  • Experience building web applications with frontend and backend functionality.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Familiarity with React or another modern frontend framework.
  • Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive web development.
  • Familiarity with Node.js or another backend development environment.
  • Understanding of APIs and frontend-to-backend communication.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL databases or relational data.
  • Familiarity with reusable frontend components and application state.
  • Ability to implement user-facing features from technical specifications or designs.
  • Understanding of common web application development patterns.
  • Ability to read and modify existing application code.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control.
  • Basic debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • Willingness to learn software testing and code quality practices.
  • Interest in building tools that help businesses manage their operations.
  • Attention to usability and the overall user experience.
  • Ability to collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate progress, challenges, and technical questions clearly.
  • Openness to mentorship, feedback, and continuous learning.
  • Ability to work independently on clearly defined tasks in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Previous software engineering internship or junior development experience.
  • Experience with TypeScript, React, and Next.js.
  • Experience building backend applications with Node.js.
  • Familiarity with SQL databases and ORM tools.
  • Experience with Prisma or Drizzle ORM.
  • Familiarity with tRPC or typed API frameworks.
  • Exposure to AWS or serverless application development.
  • Experience with SaaS dashboards or business management applications.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms or merchant tools.
  • Experience building product catalogs or storefront management interfaces.
  • Understanding of subscription commerce and recurring billing.
  • Familiarity with payment integrations such as Stripe.
  • Experience working with reusable UI components or design systems.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant SaaS applications.
  • Experience with automated testing and application deployment.
  • Interest in merchant onboarding and commerce workflows.
  • Familiarity with healthcare or telehealth software.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.
  • A GitHub profile or portfolio demonstrating full-stack web development projects.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/junior-full-stack-engineer-merchant-tools-bask-health

data.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, AI & Automation to design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions and automated workflows across Bask Health's platform.

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, and real-world business operations. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and operational teams to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify complex processes, improve efficiency, and create better experiences for merchants and internal users.

You'll be responsible for taking AI and automation initiatives from initial discovery through production. That includes understanding existing workflows, evaluating technical approaches, building integrations, developing backend services, and ensuring solutions are reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Unlike a traditional AI research role, this position is focused on applying existing AI technologies to practical engineering problems. You'll integrate large language models, build automated workflows, connect external systems, and develop production-ready software that delivers measurable operational value.

You'll also help establish reusable engineering patterns for AI-powered features, including monitoring, testing, evaluation, error handling, and appropriate human oversight.

We're looking for someone who enjoys working directly with stakeholders, understands how to turn ambiguous business problems into working software, and can balance rapid experimentation with strong production engineering standards.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications and workflow automation solutions across Bask Health.
  • Work directly with product, engineering, and operational stakeholders to understand business processes and identify automation opportunities.
  • Translate complex operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Build production-ready integrations with large language models and external AI services.
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and automation tools using TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable technologies.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing platform features and internal operational systems.
  • Build automated workflows that connect multiple applications, APIs, and data sources.
  • Develop AI-assisted tools that help teams complete repetitive or complex tasks more efficiently.
  • Implement structured outputs, tool calling, and function execution within AI-powered applications.
  • Design workflows that combine deterministic business logic with AI-driven capabilities.
  • Build reliable integrations with third-party services using REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architectures.
  • Develop systems for processing, transforming, and routing information between connected services.
  • Evaluate opportunities to automate merchant onboarding, operational processes, and administrative workflows.
  • Build reusable components and engineering patterns for future AI and automation initiatives.

  • Develop evaluation and testing strategies for AI-powered functionality.
  • Monitor AI application performance, reliability, latency, and operational costs.
  • Investigate and resolve issues involving AI outputs, integrations, and automated processes.
  • Implement logging, error handling, retry mechanisms, and monitoring for production workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate AI solutions into existing applications and services.
  • Work with SQL databases and application data to support automation and AI-powered features.
  • Evaluate third-party AI services, automation platforms, and developer tools for practical use cases.
  • Document technical architecture, implementation decisions, and operational requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to convert custom automation solutions into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
  • Mentor other engineers on reliable AI integration and automation development.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or a comparable hands-on technical role.
  • Strong programming experience with JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Experience developing backend applications, APIs, and services using Node.js or comparable technologies.
  • Hands-on experience integrating large language models or AI services into software applications.
  • Experience building automated workflows, system integrations, or operational tooling.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party integration patterns.
  • Experience developing and maintaining production software.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and working solutions.
  • Experience integrating multiple systems, services, or data sources.
  • Familiarity with prompt design, structured outputs, and practical LLM application development.
  • Understanding of error handling, validation, and reliability considerations for AI-powered workflows.
  • Experience working with SQL databases and relational data.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across application and integration layers.
  • Experience designing maintainable, scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and modern application deployment practices.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, and secure data handling.
  • Ability to evaluate technical approaches and make sound architectural decisions.
  • Experience writing tests and maintaining software quality.
  • Ability to investigate and resolve complex production issues.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers, engineers, and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage technical projects independently from discovery through deployment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguous requirements.
  • Ability to balance rapid implementation with long-term maintainability.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, remote engineering environment.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Solutions Engineer, or Automation Engineer.
  • Experience building AI agents or multi-step LLM workflows.
  • Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable AI model APIs.
  • Experience with function calling, tool use, and structured LLM responses.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases.
  • Experience with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.
  • Experience developing AI evaluation frameworks or automated quality checks.
  • Familiarity with prompt versioning, model selection, and AI cost optimization.
  • Experience implementing human-in-the-loop approval workflows.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and asynchronous processing.
  • Familiarity with AWS Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, or comparable cloud services.
  • Experience with React, Next.js, or full-stack TypeScript applications.
  • Familiarity with tRPC, Prisma, or Drizzle ORM.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, or Make.
  • Experience developing internal tools or operational automation platforms.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS applications.
  • Experience working with merchant-facing software or e-commerce platforms.
  • Experience integrating healthcare, telehealth, or pharmacy-related systems.
  • Understanding of healthcare data privacy and security considerations.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer - Document Processing (US Remote)
data.description:
TREND Health Partners is a tech-enabled payment integrity company. Our mission is to facilitate collaboration between payers and providers for mutual benefit and waste reduction, ultimately improving access to healthcare. We achieve this by aligning the common goals of payers and providers and fostering collaboration through a shared technology platform and seamless workflows.

Joining TREND Health Partners means becoming part of a dynamic, growing organization that promotes a collaborative and innovative work environment. Our comprehensive compensation package includes competitive salaries, highly valued health insurance, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid parental leave, and more.

The Principal Software Engineer will lead the development of innovative, scalable software solutions that support complex document review workflows for healthcare payers and providers. This role requires a deep understanding of modern web application architecture and cloud-native backend systems. The engineer will collaborate closely with architects, product, QA, and cloud teams to drive system-wide design decisions, optimize platform performance, and deliver new capabilities to our customers.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical leadership, a hands-on approach to coding, and the ability to mentor other engineers while ensuring alignment with architectural standards and business goals.

Role and Responsibilities

    • Lead the evolution of our document processing pipeline: designing Step Functions state machines, writing the modular Go services that run inside them, and defining contracts that let workflow steps be swapped in and out cleanly.
    • Own the hard problems around processing real-world PDFs reliably at scale — malformed input, structural variance, and performance across documents from a few pages to tens of thousands.
    • Build out operational metrics and observability — starting with the document pipeline, extending to other platform areas as needs surface.
    • Take a concept from "here's roughly the problem" to a shipped, working solution with minimal hand-holding.
    • Mentor and grow the other engineers working in this space, and advocate for the pipeline's forward progress.
    • Contribute to database design and query performance across our Postgres/RDS environment.
    • Work with OpenSearch for indexing and search functionality tied to document data.
    • Support the wider platform ecosystem beyond the core pipeline as needs come up.
    • Review code, weigh in on architecture, and help set technical direction for the team.
    • Partner with product and engineering leads to turn loose requirements into real technical designs.

Qualifications

  • Documented professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems — we're looking at what you've built and owned, not just tenure.
  • A habit of taking ownership of the problem space, driving the solution, and standing behind your decisions. We don't do blame here — when something goes wrong, we own it, learn, and move forward.
  • Strong Go experience, particularly for backend/service work.
  • Hands-on experience with document processing at scale — you understand PDF structure and edge cases well enough to reason about performance, reliability, and failure modes across variable real-world input.
  • Experience designing and implementing metrics and observability for production systems — deciding what should be measured and building it, not just consuming dashboards someone else built.
  • Comfort with AWS serverless patterns: Lambda, Step Functions, ECS, and event-driven architecture generally.
  • Solid database fundamentals — schema design, query optimization, troubleshooting performance issues.
  • A track record of driving something from an ambiguous starting point to a finished product.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound calls without a lot of oversight.
  • Strong communication — you'll need to explain tradeoffs to engineers and non-engineers alike.
  • Experience mentoring engineers day to day — not just leaving comments in code review, but actively growing the people around you.
  • Comfort handling sensitive data (PHI) responsibly and in line with HIPAA requirements.

​Preferred Skills​

  • Proficiency in C++ — not required, but a plus given some of our high-performance pipeline segments are written in it.
  • Interest or experience in Rust — not currently in use, but on the table for future performance-critical pipeline work.
  • Hands-on OpenSearch (or Lucene-based search) experience. This space doesn't have a dedicated owner today — if it's a strength of yours, there's a real opportunity to take charge of it.
  • Experience with document-centric pipelines (OCR, classification, extraction, or similar).
  • Healthcare or payment-integrity industry background.
  • Comfort using agentic coding tools as part of a modern dev workflow.

    A Note on Culture

    We're a laid-back team — plenty of memes, self-managed accountability, low ceremony. We care more about whether the work is good and the pipeline is reliable than about how you got there. We're Mac-shop, and we lean on modern tooling (including AI-assisted coding) without letting it replace engineering judgment.

Mental and Physical Demands

  • This position will be exposed mainly to an indoor office environment and will be expected to work in or around computers and printers.
  • The nature of the work is sedentary, and the employee will be sitting most of the time.
  • Essential physical functions of the job include typing and the repetitive motion to utilize computer software and hardware continuously throughout the day.
  • Essential mental functions of this position include concentrating on analytical tasks, reading information, and verbal/written communication to others continuously throughout the day.

Related Duties As Assigned

  • This job description documents the general nature and level of work but is not intended to be a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities required for this position. Consequently, employee’s may be asked to perform other duties as required.
  • Employees may also be asked to complete certain compliance requirements set forth by our Business Partners in the performance of their jobs including but not limited to requests for background and drug screenings and disclosures of personal health information or personally identifiable information. Exemptions as provided under the ADA and TITLE VII of the Civil Rights Act will be observed and followed.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions outlined above.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/principal-software-engineer-document-processing-us-remote-trend-health-partners

data.description:
Position Overview

Power your future with Qualus in our Engineering department as a Principal Civil Structural Engineer. In this role, the candidate will design and detail mat and pier type foundations for substation structures. Additionally, the candidate will design substation structures ranging from simple equipment supports to overhead line towers. All work will be performed with emphasis on quality and project costs following client’s requirements and internal company’s quality control and quality assurance practices.

The candidate may also complete substation designs, as necessary. Work will include applying applicable codes and client standards to design general arrangements, equipment and electrical layouts, elevation views, grading and fence plans, foundation plan and details, substation rigid bus arrangements, structure details, and bills of material.

This position may be based in Lake Mary, FL; Palm Beach Gardens, FL; Las Vegas, NV, Boise, ID; Raleigh, NC; or Fort Worth, TX offices or remotely in the US or Canada.

Responsibilities

  • Develop overall conceptual design plans in the initial development phase of new projects.
  • Work with renewable energy developers and other clients with support specific to schedules and cost estimates.
  • Design foundations using commercially available software such as LPILE.
  • Develop steel structure models for rigid bus and equipment supports.
  • Perform company’s Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) processes.
  • Establish and maintain professional relationships with our external business partners; Present information and respond to questions from individual or groups of clients.
  • Direct and/or participate in client meetings/job site visits to collect or deliver design and engineering data.
  • Mentor less experienced staff on a wide range of technical and project management skills.
  • Coordinate with other engineering disciplines.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelors of Science or Masters in Civil Engineering from an ABET accredited institution.
  • 15+ years of experience performing civil structural engineering calculations.
  • Proficient with drafting programs such as AutoCAD and MicroStation a plus.
  • Active Professional Engineering (PE) license
  • Experience in transmission, distribution and generating stations is a plus.
  • Must have strong analytical and computer skills. Must be able to identify necessary software to complete needed design work.
  • Experience leading and mentoring a team

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. data.title: Backend Engineer, New Grad
data.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer, New Grad to join Bask Health's engineering team and help build the software infrastructure behind our telehealth platform.

This role is designed for recent graduates and early-career engineers who have strong programming fundamentals, enjoy building software, and want to gain hands-on experience developing production backend systems.

You'll work on APIs, databases, backend services, and application logic that support patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant tools.

Our engineering stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases, with technologies such as Prisma and Drizzle used across the platform.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, receive feedback through code reviews, and gradually take ownership of more complex features as your technical skills develop.

We're looking for someone who is curious, takes initiative, learns quickly, and enjoys understanding how software works beyond the code they're assigned to write.

You don't need years of professional experience or previous healthcare industry experience. We care about your technical foundation, the projects you've built, your ability to solve problems, and your willingness to learn.

What You'll Do

  • Build, test, and maintain backend features that support Bask's telehealth platform.
  • Develop APIs, application logic, and backend services using TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Work with SQL databases to create, update, and retrieve application data.
  • Help implement backend functionality for patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant tools.
  • Learn how our serverless infrastructure works using AWS, SST, and related technologies.
  • Assist with building and maintaining integrations between internal services and third-party APIs.
  • Write clean, readable, maintainable code that follows established engineering practices.
  • Create automated tests to verify functionality and help prevent regressions.
  • Debug application issues, investigate errors, and work with experienced engineers to resolve problems.
  • Participate in code reviews and learn how to give and receive constructive technical feedback.
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers to understand how APIs connect to user-facing applications.
  • Work with product managers and engineers to understand requirements and break projects into manageable tasks.
  • Learn how to design database schemas, structure backend services, and organize application logic.
  • Help maintain documentation for APIs, backend features, and development workflows.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, and accelerate development while validating generated code.
  • Learn how to test changes in staging environments before releasing them to production.
  • Assist with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting backend services.
  • Contribute to improving existing code, reducing technical debt, and simplifying development workflows.
  • Take ownership of smaller features and gradually work toward independently delivering more complex projects.
  • Ask questions, share ideas, and actively participate in technical discussions.
  • Develop an understanding of security, data privacy, and reliability requirements for healthcare applications.
  • Continue building your technical skills through hands-on projects, feedback, and collaboration with the engineering team.

Requirements

  • Recently completed or currently completing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and basic software design principles.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another modern programming language, with an interest in developing backend applications using TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Experience building software through coursework, internships, personal projects, open-source contributions, or professional work.
  • Basic understanding of how APIs, servers, and web applications communicate.
  • Familiarity with relational databases and basic SQL concepts.
  • Understanding of Git or another version control system.
  • Ability to write readable, organized code and explain your technical decisions.
  • Familiarity with debugging, testing, and solving programming problems.
  • Interest in learning backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, and production software development.
  • Willingness to use AI-assisted development tools while understanding, reviewing, and validating the code they produce.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and ask thoughtful questions when needed.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with other engineers and incorporate feedback.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and taking responsibility for assigned work.
  • No previous healthcare industry experience required.

Nice to Have

  • Internship, co-op, freelance, or project experience involving backend development.
  • Experience building applications with TypeScript, JavaScript, or Node.js.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, tRPC, or similar API technologies.
  • Experience using PostgreSQL, MySQL, or another SQL database.
  • Familiarity with Prisma, Drizzle, or other database access tools.
  • Exposure to AWS, SST, serverless applications, or cloud deployment.
  • Experience building full-stack applications using React or Next.js.
  • Experience deploying a personal project or application to a live environment.
  • Familiarity with automated testing frameworks or test-driven development.
  • Experience building projects involving third-party API integrations.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or a portfolio of completed technical projects.
  • Experience using Cursor, Claude Code, or other AI-assisted coding tools.
  • Interest in healthcare technology, SaaS platforms, or e-commerce systems.
  • Familiarity with application security, authentication, and data privacy fundamentals.
  • Experience working on a team-based software project using Git and code reviews.

data.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/sx6tzFKwyUTPcquYzQkRFu/jobs-at-movement-labs

Movement Labs is an incubator and consulting firm that uses technology, data, and experimentation to stop fascism and build progressive power. We help progressives win and defeat MAGA extremists through year-round work grounded in research and real-world testing. Our team partners with leading advocacy groups, grassroots organizers, and electoral campaigns to develop innovative tactics, win elections, and shift power for the long term.

As the R&D powerhouse for the progressive movement, we’ve run over 100 randomized control trials (RCTs) on voter behavior and helped hundreds of organizations increase their impact. We work hard, and the environment evolves rapidly. We are adaptable, nimble, and shift quickly as needed to meet the moment. We are looking for candidates that thrive in this type of environment.

We are looking for 2 roles, Senior and Mid-level Data Engineers to join the Tech department. You will be a part of an 8-person data engineering team, and will have a lot of ownership and ability to make an impact. You’ll work cross-functionally in a collaborative, startup-like environment. 

What the work looks like for our data team: 

  • Design and implement scalable data architecture for targeting and engagement
  • Serve as technical partner to program teams
  • Extend our foundational datasets to facilitate new outreach strategies
  • Load-test our systems to prepare for elections 
  • Maintain key datasets for polling images and precinct cross-matching
  • Develop standardized experimental frameworks for testing campaign effectiveness
  • Build AI tooling that makes our own team faster — QC agents for data deliveries, the evals to trust them, and context systems that keep our repos self-documenting

Our data team’s work mixes greenfield builds, pragmatic plumbing, incident response, and operational work. The relative mix shifts with the political calendar.

This role is fully remote. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date.

Responsibilities

  • Shape the pipelines and integrations feeding our RCT platform and our foundational voter datasets: the APIs, replication, federation layers, experiment randomization, and the failure modes that come with running data systems for hundreds of partner organizations on a non-negotiable political calendar
  • Extend our data platform and orchestration layer, and optimize it for cost, runtime, and reliability so it holds up during the elections, with millions of outreach attempts
  • Lead projects that span multiple systems and teams — scoping, designing, and driving them to real milestones
  • Hold the bar on quality — test and validate your own work, review teammates' code, and mentor through that review
  • Document and communicate — make your systems understandable to teammates, stakeholders, and non-engineers
  • Rotate through on-call and rapid response, including evenings and weekends during high-stakes moments like election cycles
  • Passionate about progressive politics and leveraging data, technology, organizing and research to build political power
  • 3-6+ years of experience (Senior or Mid-level) in designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and integrations
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Experience building production software across a modern data stack — cloud data warehouses (BigQuery or similar), a transformation framework like dbt, and an orchestrator like Dagster or Airflow
  • A track record of leading technical work across multiple systems or teams, and scoping ambiguous problems end-to-end
  • Sound judgment about when to refactor, when to ship pragmatically, and how to leave systems better than you found them
  • Strong written communication — you document what you build and can explain complex systems to non-engineers
  • Genuine commitment to the mission of stopping fascism and building progressive power, and comfort operating on a political calendar

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in the progressive, political, advocacy, or nonprofit sector — including awareness of c3/c4/PAC boundaries and the sensitivities of political and voter data
  • Familiarity with election results, voter file data, and the tools campaigns use to organize, text, and contact voters
  • Experience on Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience in on-call rotations and mentoring less-experienced engineers

We’re looking for candidates with a wide range of skills and experience. If you’re excited about the job, even if you don’t match all the characteristics, we encourage you to apply.

    • Base salary of $90,000-$150,000
    • Excellent health, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, and unlimited Paid Time Off
    • Remote first culture with teammates all around the country.
    • This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. We love to keep top performers if possible.

Applications may be reviewed earlier on a rolling basis so it benefits candidates to apply as soon as possible. The application process includes a phone screen, an exercise, and a full interview with the hiring manager. Due to the nature of our work, the process is moving quickly, and we hope candidates will start as soon as possible. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States. We are not able to provide sponsorship at this time.

Movement Labs is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to economic and social justice. Women, people of color, LGBTQ people, people with disabilities, and members of other historically disenfranchised populations are strongly encouraged to apply. If you require accommodations as part of the hiring process, please contact careers@movementlabs.com.

Applications are reviewed by our hiring team—not automated systems. Our hiring process may include AI-assisted analysis of candidate materials, however, hiring decisions are made by human reviewers.

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go / AWS Streaming)
data.description:
About us:
Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end.

Job Summary:
The Senior Backend Engineer builds the backbone that connects devices in the field to the data that drives decisions. Every event from every endpoint flows through systems you design.

You will build and own high-throughput backend services in Go that ingest device telemetry through AWS IoT and Kinesis, process it in real time, and land it in Redshift for analytics and reporting. Your systems have to handle spikes without losing a single event, scale without anyone stepping in, and stay cheap enough to run at volume.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. We are hiring someone who has run streaming pipelines in production, has been paged when they broke, and has made them better every time.

Job Description:

  • Build backend services in Go: You design, build, and maintain production Go services and APIs that are fast, concurrent, well tested, and easy for the next engineer to understand.
  • Own device ingestion: You build the path from device to cloud on AWS IoT Core, covering device connectivity over MQTT, authentication, message routing, and the rules that hand data off downstream.
  • Run real-time streaming pipelines: You design and operate Kinesis Data Streams and Firehose pipelines, with partitioning strategies, consumers, retries, back-pressure, and dead-letter handling. Throughput is high and no data gets lost.
  • Model and load the warehouse: You design Redshift schemas, distribution and sort keys, and loading patterns that keep queries fast as data grows. You make sure the data that lands is correct, complete, and ready for analytics.
  • Own reliability and cost: You build monitoring, alerting, and dashboards across the pipeline with CloudWatch or similar tools, and you track latency, data loss, and AWS spend. You know the cost per million events and how to bring it down.
  • Raise the engineering bar: You lead design discussions, review code, write clear technical documents, and mentor other engineers on the team.

Requirements

  • Senior backend engineer: 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 2–3 years writing production Go. You understand goroutines, channels, and the concurrency patterns that hold up under load.
  • Streaming in production: You have built and operated streaming data pipelines with AWS Kinesis, or a comparable system such as Kafka, at meaningful scale. You understand ordering, partitioning, exactly-once and at-least-once delivery, and replay.
  • AWS IoT or device data: You have worked with AWS IoT Core or another device-telemetry ingestion platform, including MQTT, device authentication, and high-fan-in workloads.
  • Data warehouse experience: You have designed and optimized Amazon Redshift, or a similar warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery, for production analytics. You write strong SQL and know how to make slow queries fast.
  • Cloud and infrastructure: You are strong on AWS (Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and comfortable with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CDK, Docker, and CI/CD.
  • Clear communicator: You can explain an architecture trade-off to a US product team in plain English and write design documents people actually read.

About Us:

BlackSky is a real-time intelligence company. We own and operate the world's most advanced space-based intelligence platform and provide customers satellite imagery, automated analytics and high-frequency monitoring of strategic locations, economic assets and events from around the globe. BlackSky is trusted by the most demanding allied military and intelligence organizations and commercial companies to deliver foresight into critical matters that affect national security and the economy. BlackSky's data enables governments and businesses to see, understand and anticipate change as it happens, giving them the ultimate strategic advantage so they can act quickly. Our global team works with cutting-edge technology to make a difference around the world and prides itself on being people-first, customer-focused and fun.

The Ground & Control team is looking for a passionate and driven Software Engineer to join our team, the group responsible for building the autonomous software that controls and monitors BlackSky’s satellite constellation. This includes high-speed tasking, ground and space telemetry, health monitoring, and low-latency communication with ground stations worldwide. In this role, you’ll develop software that bridges the gap between hardware-level interfaces and cloud-deployed microservices. You’ll contribute to mission-critical systems that keep our satellites safe, responsive, and efficient; operating 24/7 with minimal human intervention.

You understand the importance of safety, precision, and testability, especially in autonomous systems where small errors can have big consequences. You’re comfortable applying modern software development practices and navigating both low-level and cloud-based technologies. data.title: JD Edwards Technical Functional Solution Architect
data.description:
ERP Suites is seeking Solution Architects to design and lead the technical solutions behind our client engagements.
In this technical role, you will be responsible for the architecture of JD Edwards solutions, how systems are configured, extended, integrated, and deployed, and for ensuring those designs are implemented correctly through delivery.
Success in this role requires strong technical and functional knowledge. You must understand the business processes and the technology behind them so you can create, review, explain, and defend effective solutions.
Solution Architects at ERP Suites own the solution lifecycle from discovery and requirements definition through architecture design, proposal development, technical design oversight, implementation guidance, and post-project review.

Key Responsibilities
Solution Architecture & Design

  • Lead discovery sessions to understand client business processes, objectives, challenges, and technical requirements.
  • Translate business needs into scalable, practical solution architectures and functional designs.
  • Design integrated solutions across enterprise platforms, including JD Edwards, Salesforce, AI technologies, and related business applications.
  • Evaluate solution alternatives by considering business value, implementation complexity, risk, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Produce solution architecture documents, workflow diagrams, technical specifications, and implementation roadmaps.

Client Engagement & Presales

  • Serve as a trusted advisor during presales engagements, helping clients identify the best solution for their business needs.
  • Facilitate discovery workshops and requirements sessions with executives, business users, and technical stakeholders.
  • Present solution recommendations with clear business and technical justification.
  • Support proposal development, project estimation, and implementation planning.
  • Set realistic expectations regarding project scope, timelines, costs, and delivery approach.

Delivery Leadership

  • Maintain architectural ownership throughout project delivery to ensure solutions are implemented as designed.
  • Collaborate with project managers, consultants, developers, and client teams to resolve design questions and implementation challenges.
  • Identify risks, technical constraints, and scope changes early, recommending practical solutions when adjustments are needed.
  • Review implementation progress to ensure alignment with architectural standards and client objectives.
  • Participate in post-implementation reviews and continuously improve delivery methodologies and best practices.

About You
You enjoy solving business problems just as much as technical ones. You're naturally curious, ask thoughtful questions, and quickly understand how technology can improve business operations.
You communicate effectively with both executives and technical teams, translating complex concepts into language that builds confidence and trust. You take ownership of your work, make informed decisions, and remain engaged throughout delivery to ensure your solutions achieve the intended outcomes.
You thrive in consulting environments where every client presents a unique challenge and where your ability to think strategically, collaborate effectively, and adapt quickly makes a meaningful impact.
Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience in one or more JD Edwards functional areas, including supply chain, distribution, finance, or accounting.
  • Working knowledge of JD Edwards technical architecture.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications and solution designs that development teams can use to build and implement solutions.
  • Experience leading discovery sessions and gathering requirements from business and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to estimate implementation effort, identify technical risks, and recommend practical delivery approaches.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into effective system designs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences and influence decisions through collaboration.

*JD Edwards is the foundation of our practice and remains our preferred experience. However, we will consider candidates with comparable technical solution architecture experience in another ERP platform: such as Oracle ERP Cloud, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, or NetSuite.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Consulting or professional services experience supporting multiple concurrent client engagements.
  • Experience across both presales solution architecture and post-sales implementation.
  • Experience with JD Edwards Orchestrator, AIS, or automation and low-code extension frameworks.
  • Experience with JD Edwards upgrades, code-current programs, retrofit strategy, or cloud migrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and enterprise application infrastructure, including Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
  • Experience architecting solutions that combine JD Edwards with adjacent platforms such as Salesforce, Oracle ERP Cloud, or reporting and analytics tools.
  • Experience applying AI technologies, automation platforms, or modern integration frameworks within an enterprise environment.
  • Certifications in Oracle, JD Edwards, cloud platforms, or enterprise architecture. ERP Suites supports professional development and will contribute toward relevant certifications for the right candidate.

Why ERP Suites

At ERP Suites, Solution Architects do more than design systems—they help shape client strategy and influence business outcomes. As a boutique consulting firm specializing in JD Edwards and enterprise technology solutions, we empower our architects to take ownership from initial discovery through successful delivery.
You'll work directly with clients, collaborate with experienced consultants and technical experts, and have the opportunity to make a visible impact across a wide variety of industries and technologies. If you're looking for a role where your expertise influences both business decisions and technical execution, ERP Suites offers an environment where you can grow, lead, and make a difference.
ERP Suites is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.


Company:

At ERP Suites, our focus is on helping our customers realize IT’s potential. Our comprehensive ERP solutions enable them to streamline and scale their IT products and processes. And this leads directly to improved efficiency and increased margins. We are a proud Oracle Gold Partner and champion of proactive JD Edwards management and custom product enhancements.
ERP Suites provides technical consulting, cloud services, managed services, and digital transformation solutions for some of America’s top companies. We build secure connections, improve performance, automate workloads and give them mobility. In other words, we help them stay on top.
We deliver multi-functional value through cloud services, digital transformation, ERP consulting services, ERP managed services, and software development.

Core Values:

  • Make Customers Successful
  • Be An Advisor
  • Be a teacher
  • Be a Coach
  • Have Fun
  • Do the Right Things for the ERP Suites Family
  • Adapt Quickly to Changing Roles and Environments


This is Where IT Change Starts.

  • With questions.
  • With problems that need to be solved.
  • With business needs, both immediate and long term.
  • Because technology and its impact on business isn’t getting any simpler.
  • That’s why we exist.
  • To answer the tough questions.
  • To find a solution to every problem—no matter the size or scope.
  • And to help companies not just identify IT’s potential, but realize IT

data.title: Cyber Hunt Team Leader (R-00256)
data.description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

Position Overview

True Zero Technologies is seeking an experienced Cyber Hunt Team Lead to oversee proactive threat hunting operations, advanced threat detection, and adversary analysis within complex federal environments. This leadership position is responsible for directing threat hunting missions, developing sophisticated detection methodologies, and coordinating with Security Operations Center (SOC), Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), and government teams to identify, investigate, and mitigate advanced cyber threats.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on cybersecurity experience, strong technical leadership capabilities, and deep expertise in threat hunting, endpoint and network security monitoring, adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and advanced threat detection engineering.

Job Responsibilities

    Job Responsibilities

    • Proactive Threat Hunting & Team Leadership: Lead and coordinate enterprise threat hunting missions, directing proactive investigations, advanced security analytics, and hypothesis-driven hunting activities to identify sophisticated cyber threats and previously undetected malicious activity across federal systems.
    • Advanced Threat Detection & Adversary Analysis: Analyze adversary behaviors, attack patterns, and emerging threats, including advanced persistent threats (APTs), to identify potential compromises, uncover security weaknesses, and develop actionable recommendations to strengthen enterprise defenses.
    • Cross-Functional Security Collaboration: Coordinate with SOC analysts, Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) teams, cybersecurity business partners, and government stakeholders to investigate threats, share intelligence, validate findings, and support coordinated detection and mitigation efforts.
    • Threat Hypothesis Development & Detection Engineering: Develop and refine threat hunting hypotheses, behavioral analytics, detection logic, and security monitoring use cases to improve the identification of malicious activity across endpoint, network, and enterprise security environments.
    • Threat Intelligence & Indicator Management: Establish and maintain a centralized knowledge base of indicators of compromise (IOCs), adversary TTPs, threat hunting findings, and detection methodologies to support repeatable investigations, intelligence sharing, and continuous improvement of security operations.
    • Purple Team Exercises & Threat Emulation: Support and lead collaborative Purple Team exercises and adversary emulation activities to assess security detection capabilities, simulate realistic attack techniques, identify monitoring gaps, and recommend enhancements to defensive controls.
    • Security Framework Alignment & Continuous Improvement: Leverage MITRE ATT&CK and recognized threat hunting methodologies to map adversary techniques, evaluate detection coverage, improve hunting procedures, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to threat hunting and security operations personnel.

Job Requirements

    Job Requirements

    • Cybersecurity & Threat Hunting Experience: Minimum of 10 years of progressive cybersecurity experience, including hands-on threat hunting, security monitoring, incident investigation, threat detection, or related defensive security disciplines within complex enterprise environments.
    • Professional Certifications: Must possess at least one of the following certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
    • Threat Detection Technologies & Security Frameworks: Demonstrated hands-on experience with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Network Detection and Response (NDR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms, MITRE ATT&CK, and adversary emulation techniques, including developing and executing advanced threat hunting methodologies.
    • Operating Systems, Networking & Adversary Techniques: Strong technical understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems, enterprise networking, network protocols, endpoint security, and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), with the ability to analyze sophisticated attack activity across enterprise infrastructure.
    • Technical Leadership & Threat Intelligence Collaboration: Proven ability to lead threat hunting initiatives, develop threat hypotheses and detection logic, coordinate complex security investigations, and collaborate with SOC, CTI, engineering, and government stakeholders to identify, assess, and mitigate advanced cybersecurity threats.

TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About the role

HWA International builds the trust accounting software that bank trust departments, credit unions,
foundations, and family offices run their fiduciary operations on. We are an AI-first engineering
organization, and agentic coding tools are how we build. Our platform is in a significant modernization,
and this role is one of the engineers who builds it.
Agentic tooling lets us understand existing behavior and specify what comes next far faster than that
work could be done by hand. You will use it to do exactly that, then build the modern platform end to
end: the C# and .NET services, the web front end, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. This is a full-
stack role, and you own the infrastructure your work runs on.
Accounting accuracy is the product, so correctness is the bar. Anything new has to produce the same
results as what it replaces, or better, and proving that is part of the job.
You will work within an architecture set by engineering leadership, with real influence on it. We work to
modern engineering standards: trunk-based development on GitHub, continuous integration,
infrastructure as code, and feature flags.

What you will do

• Build the modern platform across the stack. Write features, services, and fixes in C# and .NET,
and the web front end that sits on them, against the architecture and patterns the team has set.
• Own the infrastructure for what you deliver. Within the cloud architecture engineering
leadership sets, define and maintain your AWS environments as code, along with the
networking, managed databases, and services behind them, so every environment is
reproducible and version controlled.
• Own delivery and observability. Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, staged rollout, and feature
flags that take your work to production, and the monitoring, logging, and alerting that tell us
how it behaves there.
• Work out what existing code does and write it down. Use agentic tooling to analyze established
application and database logic, then produce a clear written specification of the behavior that
has to be preserved.
• Move business logic into application code and prove it matches. Relocate rules wherever they
live today, including inside the database, into maintainable, tested application code. Build the
data migration paths and test harnesses that show the modern platform's calculations match

the existing ones.

• Verify what the tools give you. Agentic tooling drafts the analysis, the documentation, and
much of the code. An agent's account of what existing code does is a hypothesis until you have
read the code and confirmed it. Characterization tests come before behavior changes.
• Own the work in production. Whatever ships under your name is yours, from the first analysis
through to how it behaves in production. Take part in incident response, communicate clearly
while an issue is open, and follow through to root cause and a durable fix.

What we are looking for

You do not need to be an expert in every layer. Agentic tools let one strong engineer work across the full
stack and the infrastructure under it, so we look for depth where judgment matters most, enough
working knowledge everywhere else to direct the tools and catch their mistakes, and fluency with the
tools from day one.
Where you need depth
• Several years of professional C# and .NET development, with production code you can describe
and defend.
• Strong relational database skills: schema design, query tuning, and correct transaction and error
handling by reflex. PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to work out what unfamiliar code does, including code written in a
language or platform you have not used before, and a repeatable method for doing it safely.
• Agentic coding is table stakes. Deep, hands-on fluency with agentic tools (Claude Code, GitHub
Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as your primary way of working on real production code, from day
one, with the judgment to treat what they produce as work to be checked rather than answers
to be shipped.
Where working knowledge is enough
• Front end: a modern web framework, React with TypeScript preferred.
• Cloud: AWS (Azure considered), infrastructure as code, networking, managed databases, and
containers.
• Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing and zero-downtime deployment, plus production
monitoring and alerting.
Across everything
• Git and GitHub, with trunk-based development and short-lived branches.
• Comfort owning quality on a system that cannot fail quietly: disciplined testing, observability,
and careful, staged rollout.
• Clear written and spoken English, because much of your working contact with the team is
written.
• Availability to work hours that overlap the first half of the US Eastern working day, so you work
with your counterparts rather than around them.

Nice to have

• Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-stakes domain. Trust accounting,
wealth management, or fiduciary services is a strong plus but is not required. We will teach the

domain to the right engineer.

• Experience modernizing an established business application onto a cloud-native stack.
• AWS certification or equivalent depth in security, identity, and cost management on AWS.
• Building software under SOC 1 / SOC 2 or comparable regulated-environment controls.

Recruitment Notice

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

Beware of Recruitment Scams

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

Protect yourself by following these steps:

  • Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware.com email address.
  • Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
  • If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond — instead, forward it to and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

About RHONDOS

RHONDOS is the recognized leader in SAP security and observability — trusted by Fortune 500 and Fortune 2000 enterprises globally to secure and observe their most mission-critical systems. Our PowerConnect solution delivers real-time threat detection, compliance automation, and deep operational visibility across SAP environments, on market-leading platforms including Splunk, Dynatrace, and Elastic. We maintain strategic partnerships with global systems integrators, ISVs, and VARs.

We are a rapidly growing and profitable business with a lean, highly skilled team operating with a distributed team across the globe. We move fast, think strategically, and build things that last.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Director, Solutions Engineering to lead presales at RHONDOS, reporting to the President & Chief Product Officer. You will lead our sales engineering function worldwide and own how RHONDOS designs, demonstrates, and proves PowerConnect for customers and partners.

Beyond the deal cycle, you will own market research and competitive analysis, set the standards for demos and POCs, and run the feedback loop that brings what the field learns back to Product and Engineering. This role suits a presales leader who still likes being hands-on, has worked closely with product or project management, and wants to build a function at a company where that work has visible impact.

What You'll Do

•     Lead, coach, and hire sales engineers in partnership with regional GTM leaders so every region runs to the same presales standards

•     Own presales capacity and deal coverage with regional sales leaders, and track technical win rate, POC conversion, and cycle time to keep improving how the team works

•     Set the standards for technical discovery, demos, and POCs, including success criteria, timelines, and close-out reviews, and hold the team to them

•     Build and maintain demo environments, reference architectures, and solution patterns across Splunk, Cisco, Dynatrace, and other supported platforms, and lead hands-on evaluation of new platforms and technologies we could support

•     Engage directly on strategic and complex opportunities as the senior technical voice, including helping customers build the technical and business case for PowerConnect

•     Own technical responses to RFPs and architecture reviews, and maintain a reusable response library

•     Scope deployments accurately and run clean handoffs to Customer Success and Professional Services so what we sell is what gets delivered

•     Own market research and competitive analysis: track the SAP security and observability landscape, maintain competitive positioning, and equip the field to win against alternatives

•     Run the feedback loop from the field to Product and Engineering: capture customer requirements, product gaps, and win/loss themes, and bring them to roadmap discussions with clear evidence

•     Deliver technical enablement for RHONDOS sellers and for partner technical teams at Cisco/Splunk and Dynatrace

•     Work with Marketing on technical messaging so solution content, launches, and competitive materials are accurate and reflect how customers actually deploy

•     Represent RHONDOS at partner and industry events such as Splunk .conf, Dynatrace Perform, and SAP community events; travel approximately 25%

Your First Year

•     First 30 days: Join live deals in every region and sit in on discovery, demos, and POCs. Get hands-on with PowerConnect and meet our key technical contacts at Cisco/Splunk and Dynatrace

•     Days 31–60: Act as the senior technical voice on our top opportunities and document what is working and what isn't. Design a technical enablement program for Cisco/Splunk and Dynatrace partner teams

•     Days 61–90: Turn what you've seen in live deals into a first version of demo and POC standards, and bring a presales plan into next fiscal year's planning: coverage, headcount, metrics, and targets

•     Months 4–12: Make the standards how every region works, launch partner enablement, and run the team against its annual targets, with technical win rate as the headline measure

What You Bring

Required

•     8+ years in presales, solutions engineering, or solution architecture for enterprise software, including 3+ years leading a sales engineering team

•     A track record of running demos and POCs that convert in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles

•     Strong technical grounding in enterprise observability, security analytics, or data platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or Elastic

•     Working knowledge of SAP landscapes, or the technical depth to get there quickly

•     Hands-on exposure to product management or project management: requirements, roadmaps, or structured delivery

•     Experience building team standards, enablement programs, or playbooks that others adopt

•     Experience leading a distributed team across time zones

•     Clear communication with technical and executive audiences, internal and external

•     Resident in and legally authorized to work in the United States

Bonus Points

•     Presales or partner experience at Splunk, Cisco, Dynatrace, or another observability or security vendor

•     Experience selling with and through technology partners and systems integrators

•     SAP Basis, SAP security, or GRC background

•     Formal competitive intelligence or market research experience

•     Experience building a presales function at a small or scaling software company

•     Splunk, Dynatrace, or security certifications

Competitive US benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), paid time off, and company holidays.

We also offer:

•     A fully remote-first working environment with genuine flexibility

•     Company-provided equipment

•     Direct exposure to a global enterprise customer base and partner ecosystem

•     A small, high-caliber team where your work has immediate impact

•     Room to grow the Solutions Engineering team as the business scales

Culture

We move fast, trust each other, and hold ourselves accountable to outcomes over activity.

•     Positive Reciprocity — Mutual success with customers, partners, and each other

•     Play to Win — With discipline, clarity, and velocity

•     Customer Obsession — We are relentless about customer success

•     Do the Right Thing — Even when it's harder

This Role Is Not for Everyone

If you want a large presales organization with dedicated demo engineers, competitive analysts, and enablement staff, this probably isn't the right fit. Here you lead the team and still do the work: you will build demos, write competitive briefs, and join deals yourself. If you want to build a presales function and shape how a growing company sells, we'd like to talk.

Company Overview: Atreides helps organisations turn large, complex, multimodal datasets into detailed geospatial data, that can be used for a wide range of use cases. At present, Atreides focuses on providing high-fidelity data that allows customers to make decisions quickly.

We are a fast-moving, high-performing start-up. We value having a diverse team and believe that inclusion helps us perform better. We trust our people to work independently, as we believe this leads to better results and greater job satisfaction. With a mission-driven mindset and an entrepreneurial spirit, we are building something new and helping to harness data on a massive scale to make the world safer, stronger and more prosperous.

Team Overview: Our teams are made up of engineers and technologists that solve hard problems. Between us, we have decades of experience in defence, operational intelligence, law enforcement, hyperscalers, big data processors and cyber security operations. We obsess about designing products that will change the way governments, international companies and non-profit organisations protect themselves from external threats and hostile adversaries

Position Overview: We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect to support the design and delivery of secure, scalable and resilient Microsoft Azure environments that support critical defence platforms. You will work with colleagues and stakeholders from a range of disciplines, based around the world, to shape mission-focused cloud strategies that meet strict security and performance requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain Azure Mission Environments using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or Bicep), aligned to the Cloud Adoption Framework and customer security requirements.
  • Design secure, performant solutions to integrate sensors and data with Mission Environments that scale, have resilience and cost efficiency.
  • Engineer and operate Azure networking, including:
    i. Hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN topologies, VNet peering and route tables (UDRs) and vWAN
    ii. Azure Firewall, NSGs, Application Gateway / WAF and Front Door
    iii. Private Endpoints, Private Link and Private DNS zone design
    iv. Hybrid connectivity: site-to-site VPN, ExpressRoute and BGP routing
  • Design, configure and manage Cloudflare services, including:

    i. DNS management and zone configuration

    ii.Firewall rules, rate limiting, bot management and DDoS protection
    iii. Cloudflare Zero Trust / Access, Tunnels and secure application publishing
    iv. Certificate and TLS configuration, caching and performance tuning
    v. Managing Cloudflare configuration as code

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure, software solutions and platform deployments, including plan/apply workflows, approvals, testing and drift detection.
  • Implement and enforce governance through Azure Policy, management group hierarchy, RBAC, Privileged Identity Management and tagging and cost standards.
  • Implement platform security controls, including Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Key Vault, managed identities, diagnostic logging and Microsoft Sentinel integration.
  • Build observability with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana and alerting, ensuring platforms are supportable and evidence is available for assurance.
  • Act as a Level 2/3 escalation point for complex platform, networking and connectivity issues, leading root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
  • Act as a point of contact for downstream data consumers of the platforms.
  • Lead integration of emerging capabilities – such as mobile platforms and zero-trust architectures – into legacy or hybrid estates.
  • Collaboratively work with wider Atreides Engineering teams on product updates and feedback.
  • Drive operational excellence through monitoring, capacity planning and cost control across cloud workloads.
  • Collaborate with Defence partners, third-party vendors and internal teams to ensure solutions meet programme requirements and security mandates.
  • Maintain architecture standards, patterns and run-books to support audit readiness, compliance and onboarding.

Required Qualifications:

  • Deep expertise in Azure architecture, infrastructure and engineering, including landing zone design and Azure Policy
  • A strong grounding in networking (VPNs, firewalls, routing, switching and ExpressRoute) and in security-by-design principles
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform and/or Bicep, including writing reusable modules, managing state and promoting changes safely across environments
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience supporting defence, intelligence or government clients, ideally in secure or classified environments
  • A Microsoft Azure certification, such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator Associate) or AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert), or equivalent hands-on experience

Eligibility Requirements

  • Right to work in Denmark: because of defence sector restrictions, candidates must be EU/EEA nationals or already hold a Danish work permit
  • Security clearance: you must be eligible for Danish SECRET clearance. Atreides will sponsor the vetting process for the successful candidate.

Nice to Have

  • Azure certifications: AZ-400 (Azure DevOps Engineer Expert), AZ-500 (Azure Security Engineer Associate) or AZ-700 (Azure Network Engineer Associate)
  • Experience using Python for infrastructure automation
  • CCNA or an equivalent networking qualification
  • Working proficiency in Danish
