data.description:
Leidos is seeking a Network Engineer to support Federal Civil customer in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.

LOCATION: This position is remote; however, prefer candidates that are within driving distance to the Washington, DC area.

CLEARANCE: Must be a U.S. Citizen capable of obtaining and maintaining a Public Trust clearance prior to start.

POSITION SUMMARY:

This role supports the engineering, operation, maintenance, and modernization of secure, mission-critical enterprise networks across geographically distributed environments.

Working alongside the Senior Network Engineer, you’ll implement, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network solutions across on-premises and hybrid cloud infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with engineering, cybersecurity, and service desk teams to keep the network available, high-performing, and secure while supporting modernization efforts. You’ll also contribute to documentation, configuration management, and continuous service improvement.

A strong foundation in networking and the ability to work across multiple network technologies are essential.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Serve as a Tier 2/3 technical resource for operational and engineering issues affecting mission-critical enterprise infrastructure, escalating complex architectural challenges to the Senior Network Engineer as needed.
  • Assist in the planning, deployment, configuration, and maintenance of network infrastructure solutions across geographically distributed, multi-vendor environments.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot technical network issues involving multiple systems, implementing approved corrective actions to maintain network reliability, performance, and security.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise routing and switching infrastructure, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, routing redundancy, and network failover.
  • Administer and support enterprise network security solutions, including Cisco Firepower, Firepower Management Center (FMC), ASA, firewall rule updates, access controls, and security hardening.
  • Implement, monitor, and sustain secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN solutions, including Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect and connectivity with external partners and vendors.
  • Support and maintain hybrid cloud network connectivity integrating on-premises infrastructure with AWS networking services, including VPCs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and load balancing.
  • Administer enterprise wireless networking and network access control technologies, including Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
  • Support the execution of network infrastructure upgrades, modernization initiatives, lifecycle replacements, and security remediation activities under the technical guidance of senior engineering staff.
  • Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity; assist in gathering metrics and implementing approved improvements to strengthen service delivery and operational resilience.
  • Participate in incident investigations and root cause analysis, gathering diagnostic data and executing corrective and preventive tasks.
  • Collaborate with internal engineering teams, cybersecurity teams, vendors, and service providers to troubleshoot issues, coordinate maintenance windows, and implement technical tasks.
  • Update and maintain network diagrams, configuration records, technical implementation plans, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Execute incident, problem, change, and service request management tickets while ensuring technical accuracy, thorough documentation, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Partner with the Senior Network Engineer to test and implement network automation scripts, configuration templates, and process improvements to increase operational efficiency.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree and 4 years’ experience; additional years of experience accepted in lieu of degree.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, administering, and troubleshooting complex enterprise network infrastructure in production environments.
  • Strong working knowledge and hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and network redundancy/failover.
  • Hands-on experience supporting and administering Cisco and/or Juniper enterprise networking platforms (such as Juniper EX/QFX & Junos OS, and Cisco ISR & IOS devices) in multi-vendor environments.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise network security infrastructure, including Cisco ASA, Firepower & FMC, access control policies, and remote-access VPN solutions (Cisco AnyConnect/Secure Client).
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot multi-system network issues, assist with root cause analysis (RCA), and implement approved corrective actions.
  • Experience executing network infrastructure changes, device upgrades, and security remediation activities in production environments following established change control procedures.
  • Experience updating and maintaining accurate network diagrams, technical documentation, configuration records, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with experience working alongside senior engineers, cross-functional teams, vendors, and ISPs to resolve operational issues.
  • Familiarity or hands-on experience supporting AWS network infrastructure and hybrid cloud connectivity (e.g., VPCs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateways, load balancers).
  • Experience administering enterprise wireless infrastructure and Network Access Control (NAC) solutions, such as Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
  • Exposure to virtual computing platforms (e.g., VMware/vSphere) as they relate to network connectivity, as well as Cisco CUCM/UC voice solutions.
  • Active Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification.
  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8140 / IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CySA+, CCNA-Security, GSEC, SSCP).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Cisco Certified CCNP or Juniper JNCIP-ENT.
  • Experience with Cisco Meraki wireless solutions.
  • Experience with Cisco ISE.
  • Experience with Dell switches and OS10.
  • Experience with ServiceNow.
  • Security+ CE certification.

data.description:
8x8 connects our customers and teams globally, empowering CX leaders with performance and insights to make smarter decisions, delight customers, and drive lasting business impact.

Director, Site Reliability Engineering

8x8 connects our customers and teams globally. Our XCaaS platform, the 8x8 Experience Communications Platform, brings voice, video, chat, contact center and communications APIs together in one cloud platform, so organizations can deliver better employee and customer experiences. Millions of people rely on it every day, and reliability is at the center of what we deliver.

Our engineering teams own their services in production. We are now building a central Site Reliability Engineering team with a platform-wide view. It will define how we measure reliability, build the tools and standards that help every team run their services well, and engineer shared points of failure out of the platform before they affect customers. We are looking for the Director who will build and lead it.

What will you do?

You will build 8x8's central SRE function from the ground up and lead a team across US and EU time zones. Your team will set service level objectives for our most important customer flows, improve observability and work with engineering teams to ensure the platform has the capacity and redundancy it needs. You will own the platform's dependency map and shared-infrastructure inventory, set the operational standards every service is held to, and prove through regular testing that failover works. Engineering teams keep ownership of their services. Your team covers the parts of the platform that no single team owns and raises the reliability bar for everyone.

Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a global SRE team across US and EU time zones, including its charter, operating model, hiring and career development.
  • Define the reliability strategy and multi-year roadmap for the 8x8 platform, aligned with business and customer priorities.
  • Establish SLIs, SLOs and error budgets for critical customer journeys, and use them to guide engineering priorities and balance release velocity with stability.
  • Set platform-wide standards for observability, including monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting, with a focus on actionable, customer-impacting signals.
  • Drive the reduction of operational toil through automation, self-service tooling, and infrastructure and configuration as code.
  • Partner with platform and CI/CD teams to build reliability into the software delivery lifecycle, including progressive rollouts and automated rollback.
  • Own capacity planning and performance engineering for shared infrastructure and high-traffic services.
  • Maintain a comprehensive view of service dependencies and shared infrastructure, and lead the identification and remediation of single points of failure.
  • Lead resilience and disaster recovery programs, including regular failover testing across data centers and game days for critical components.
  • Establish production readiness standards and reviews for new services and high-risk infrastructure changes.
  • Partner with the incident management team to strengthen incident response processes, and participate in high-severity incidents to provide platform-wide technical expertise and help restore service quickly.
  • Champion a blameless postmortem culture and ensure that lessons learned and corrective actions are carried through to completion.
  • Serve as a trusted reliability partner to engineering, product and executive leadership, and report on platform reliability and progress against goals.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years in site reliability, infrastructure, platform or production engineering, including 5+ years leading SRE or infrastructure teams.
  • Has built or scaled an SRE or reliability function, with measurable results such as improved availability, SLO adoption or reduced toil.
  • Strong SRE practice: SLIs and SLOs, error budgets, observability, toil reduction, capacity planning, production readiness reviews and blameless postmortems.
  • Experience with incident management practices and with participating in high-severity incident response in large-scale production environments.
  • Deep infrastructure knowledge: networking, load balancers and high-availability pairs, DNS, firewalls and NAT, virtualization, and public cloud (AWS preferred).
  • Experience running services across both company-operated data centers and public cloud, including multi-site failover and disaster recovery.
  • A software engineering background: can write automation and tooling, read code and debug distributed applications.
  • Comfortable with Linux, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (for example Terraform or Ansible), Kafka or similar messaging systems, and relational databases at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools (for example Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Can set standards and get commitments from engineering teams that do not report to you.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to explain reliability to executives in business terms.

Preferred

  • Experience with real-time communications: VoIP, SIP, WebRTC
  • Experience with enterprise load balancers and network devices such as F5, Citrix ADC or Fortinet.
  • Chaos engineering or game-day programs.
  • Service catalogs and dependency mapping (for example Backstage).
  • Experience leading teams across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

data.description:
POS-33677

Application Deadline: Monday, November 23rd at 9am ET

Please note: Due to close working relationships with teams in Ireland and the UK, we are only considering candidates who are located in the Eastern time zone (US).

Role Summary

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. On the Operations Web Team, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring the systems behind HubSpot’s digital experiences are reliable, scalable, and built to grow with our customers. This is a highly visible team responsible for delivering innovative web platforms and applications that power HubSpot’s global brand and are experienced by millions every day.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll design and operate the infrastructure that supports high-traffic, data-intensive marketing platforms and systems. You'll also work across our Cloudflare edge platform, including opportunities to lead experiments and initiatives in areas like web personalization as they develop. You’ll partner closely with developers and stakeholders to improve delivery velocity while upholding strong standards for security, performance, and operational excellence. Together, we’re on a mission to build the best web experience in the world, and the reliability of our platforms is foundational to that goal.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure for high-traffic, business-critical applications, improving it through automation and observability.
  • Operate and improve our Cloudflare edge platform (CDN, caching, WAF, DNS), and contribute to edge experiments and initiatives - such as traffic routing, staged rollouts, and personalization - as those efforts grow.
  • Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews, ensuring learnings are translated into systemic improvements.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, and establish and evolve infrastructure-as-code standards for consistency, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Use AI-assisted tooling in day-to-day DevOps work and help the team adopt what proves valuable for reliability, delivery velocity, and cost efficiency.
  • Own medium-to-large infrastructure initiatives from design through production, including documentation, runbooks and long-term support.
  • Contribute to sprint planning, backlog refinement, and roadmap planning, helping prioritize infrastructure investments that improve reliability, scalability, and developer velocity.
  • Evaluate technical trade-offs and clearly communicate risks, impact, and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders across Web Development, QA, and Product.
  • Support the growth of less-experienced engineers through informal mentoring, code review, and sharing best practices in DevOps and cloud architecture.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or infrastructure-focused software engineering roles.
  • Significant experience operating production systems in at least one major public cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Practical experience with infrastructure as code, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Hands-on experience operating Cloudflare in production - CDN and caching, WAF, and DNS.
  • Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with containers and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience operating large-scale, customer-facing, highly distributed systems in production.
  • Strong troubleshooting, prioritization, and communication skills - able to drive complex issues to resolution, manage competing work with minimal oversight, and explain technical concepts clearly.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience designing, running, or measuring controlled changes at the edge (traffic splitting, staged rollouts, A/B testing, or personalization), including production experience with edge compute such as Cloudflare Workers, KV, or R2.
  • Familiarity with web technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js.
  • Exposure to observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering or operations tools to improve productivity or system reliability.
  • A collaborative approach to mentoring or supporting other engineers.

Where You’ll Work

  • Location: United States (East Coast)
  • Work location preference eligibility: Remote
  • Travel/Shift: None

Application Requirements

  • Applications must be submitted by: Monday, November 23rd at 9am ET
  • Applications must be submitted in: English
  • Cover letters: Optional

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:

$108,300—$162,500 USD

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

data.title: IT Support Manager - Microsoft Managed Services
data.description:
TEKenable is seeking a dynamic Support Manager to lead our managed services support team. The Support Manager is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of an ITIL-aligned Managed Services team, delivering high-quality support across Microsoft cloud-focused solutions including Azure, .NET-based applications, Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.

The role requires proactive ownership of support operations, identifying and addressing service risks, customer concerns, SLA risks, ageing or stalled tickets and potential escalations before intervention is required. The Support Manager is responsible not only for monitoring and reporting service performance, but for analysing trends and underlying issues, identifying risks and improvement opportunities, recommending appropriate actions and driving those actions through to completion. The role will ensure service stability, effective incident and problem management, high customer satisfaction and continuous improvement across service operations.

The role holder can work remotely, but the position is open to applicants in either Ireland or the UK only.

TEKenable is a leader in digital transformation, specialising in Microsoft cloud solutions and recognised for excellence in AI and Data. With a global presence and a remote-first policy, we deliver innovative managed services to clients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

Service Coordination & Delivery

  • Act as the operational bridge between the Service Delivery Manager and functional delivery teams.
  • Ensure service levels, KPIs, and contractual obligations are consistently met.
  • Support the Service Delivery Manager in contractual compliance, reporting, and client satisfaction initiatives.
  • Serve as the point of coordination for internal teams, ensuring smooth communication between technical functions and service management.
  • Produce regular and ad hoc reports, dashboards, KPI metrics and presentations for internal stakeholders, ensuring data accuracy and clarity.
  • Analyse service performance data to identify trends, underlying causes, risks and areas requiring action, providing clear recommendations rather than reporting metrics in isolation.
  • Engage with client operational stakeholders on service delivery matters, while the Service Delivery Manager retains responsibility for overall client relationship, governance, and commercial performance.
  • Participate in client service reviews, governance meetings, and operational reporting sessions alongside the Service Delivery Manager.
  • Provide service performance insights, trend analysis, and improvement recommendations to client stakeholders.
  • Build trusted relationships with client operational leads, ensuring alignment between business needs and service delivery.

Operational Ownership

  • Own day-to-day ticket operations including prioritisation, assignment, and SLA adherence
  • Own operational issues and escalations through to resolution, ensuring actions are clearly assigned, tracked and followed through to completion.
  • Proactively identify service risks, SLA risks, ageing or stalled tickets, customer concerns and potential escalations, taking appropriate action before management or customer intervention is required.
  • Manage backlog, ageing tickets, and escalation handling
  • Coordinate Major Incidents from identification through resolution, ensuring timely internal and customer communication, clear ownership of actions, and appropriate RCA and follow-up activities.
  • Ensure Problem Management activities reduce repeat incidents
  • Manage service delivery across multiple clients, balancing competing priorities and ensuring effective allocation of shared resources
  • Manage prioritisation between BAU support activities and minor enhancements (run vs change)
  • Establish and maintain regular ticket quality reviews, ensuring appropriate documentation, customer communication, troubleshooting, categorisation and adherence to agreed support processes.

Operational Excellence

  • Monitor incident and request volumes, escalation trends, and service performance.
  • Provide input into dashboards, reports, and forecasting models to support proactive service management.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with the Service Delivery Manager and Director of Managed Services.
  • Ensure ITIL-aligned processes are embedded and followed across delivery teams.
  • Identify gaps in process adherence and recommend improvements.
  • Understand, comply with and actively promote adherence to ISO27001 and ISO9001 policies and procedures.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong grounding in ITIL v4 practices (Foundation certification required; Intermediate/Managing Professional desirable).
  • Proven experience in managed services delivery coordination within enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with incident, problem, change, and request management processes.
  • Experience working in multi-location delivery models, ideally with offshore/nearshore coordination.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
  • Analytical mindset with experience in KPI tracking, reporting, and service performance analysis.
  • Exposure to Microsoft technology stack (Business Central, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform)
  • Previous experience using Delivery Platforms (FreshService, Datadog)

Key Competencies

  • Proactive Ownership & Accountability – takes ownership of service operations, identifies risks and issues early, takes appropriate action and drives activities through to completion without requiring continual management intervention.
  • Leadership & People Development – able to motivate, coach, and manage diverse teams across geographies.
  • Process-driven mindset with attention to compliance and governance.
  • Collaborative leadership—able to influence without direct authority.
  • Analytical and Data-Driven Thinking – able to interpret service data, identify trends and underlying causes, assess risks and translate findings into meaningful insight and clear recommendations.
  • Resilience and adaptability in managing escalations and shifting priorities.
  • Continuous improvement orientation—always seeking efficiency and service quality gains.
  • Initiative & Tooling for Improvement – proactively identifies opportunities to enhance delivery and leverages automation, dashboards, and service management tooling (e.g., ITSM platforms, monitoring, reporting, and analytics) to drive measurable improvements in performance, transparency, and client value.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication – communicates clearly with customers, technical teams and management, and is comfortable challenging, escalating and influencing where appropriate.

Why apply

  • Remote-first flexibility anywhere from Ireland or the UK with global collaboration across Spain, Hungary, and UAE.
  • Industry-leading transformation challenges using Microsoft tech in AI, Dynamics, and Data solutions.
  • Professional recognition, including Deloitte Fast 50, Microsoft Business Applications Partner of the Year, and more.
  • Career growth through coaching, structured development, and international exposure.

Requirements

  • Strong grounding in ITIL v4 practices (Foundation certification required; Intermediate/Managing Professional desirable).
  • Proven experience in managed service delivery coordination within enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with incident, problem, change, and request management processes.
  • Experience working in multi-location delivery models, ideally with offshore/nearshore coordination.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
  • Analytical mindset with experience in KPI tracking, reporting, and service performance analysis.
  • Exposure to Microsoft technology stack (Business Central, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform)
  • Previous experience using ITSM Platform

TEKenable's culture is built upon the values of resilience, heartfelt service, always striving and insatiable curiosity. You can learn more about our values at www.tekenable.ie. Candidates applying for this role need to be able to demonstrate how they have applied these values in other roles and how they'll contribute to them, should they be successful.

At TEKenable we foster a culture of diversity and inclusion as we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of gender, disability, sexual orientation, generation, ethnicity, religion, family or parental status, neurodiversity or belief.

Hiring Process

Once you are successfully selected for interview a dedicated talent acquisition manager will reach out and arrange a short pre-screening call. We want to learn more about you and the experience you can bring to the position. The interview process will have 2-3 stages and we will work around your availability. You will the opportunity to talk with our recruitment team at various points throughout the process. All interview stages will be conducted remotely via video calls and arranged at a time that fits with your schedule. We will close the position once the role is filled.

Benefits

Equipment - We'll set you up with a laptop and any other equipment you might need to get the job done.

Training & Development Support - We invest in your professional growth through structured learning opportunities, certifications, and career development pathways tailored to your role and ambitions.

Sports & Social Events - Join a vibrant community through regular sports activities, team outings, and social events that bring colleagues together and foster meaningful connections beyond work.

Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - Access confidential support, counselling, and well-being resources through our Employee Assistance Programme ,because your mental and emotional health matter just as much as your professional success.

Role Description

As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will lead the migration to FleetDM and build the shared platform capabilities that support dependable endpoint operations. You will combine hands-on engineering with technical planning, partnering with Windows, macOS, and Linux engineers to introduce changes safely across a distributed environment.
You will develop automation, integrations, and configuration-as-code workflows, validate platform capabilities, and guide phased adoption. Beyond migration, you will improve platform reliability, visibility, and maintainability, helping the team reduce manual work and operate the service with shared ownership.
You will partner with Security, IAM, CorpInfra, and support teams to resolve dependencies and make practical trade-offs. This is an individual-contributor position with technical leadership and mentoring responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the FleetDM migration. Define scope, requirements, architecture, dependencies, and a phased delivery plan with OS specialists and partner teams.
  • Engineer and operate the shared platform. Maintain configuration, agent workflows, policies, queries, integrations, and operational automation.
  • Make deployment safe and repeatable. Build version-controlled configuration with automated checks, peer review, controlled rollout, drift detection, and recovery.
  • Validate capabilities and coexistence. Identify gaps, clarify management authority, and establish which responsibilities should migrate or remain with existing tools.
  • Make platform health actionable. Establish trustworthy device populations, data freshness, enrollment and agent health, and owned remediation workflows.
  • Protect service continuity. Use representative pilots, acceptance gates, employee-impact checks, and clear pause and recovery decisions.
  • Strengthen team capability. Create reusable patterns, documentation, and shared support coverage through pairing, mentoring, and operational handoffs.
  • Improve efficiency and cost. Reduce recurring manual work and recommend tooling consolidation where evidence supports it.

Requirements

  • Significant hands-on experience engineering enterprise endpoint platforms, including deep expertise in at least one of Windows, macOS, or Linux and experience working across OS boundaries.
  • Personal ownership of a multi-phase platform migration or comparable change, including discovery, pilots, rollout, recovery, and operational handover.
  • Strong practical programming or scripting skills, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, or shell, with production automation and API integration experience.
  • Demonstrated use of Git, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for configuration or infrastructure changes.
  • Ability to diagnose enrollment, agent, policy, identity, networking, and integration failures and distinguish missing data from healthy devices.
  • Experience establishing monitoring, failure handling, least-privilege access, secrets management, and maintainable operational workflows.
  • Ability to independently define priorities, align cross-functional stakeholders, communicate trade-offs, and mentor engineers.
  • Clear written and verbal communication and effective asynchronous collaboration across regions.

Preferred Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to C-level stakeholders and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Haves:

What We Offer/ Benefits

Our Commitment to Diversity

At Nethermind, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We believe a variety of perspectives drives innovation and leads to better solutions for the blockchain community.

Ready to Join Us?

Recruitment scams are becoming increasingly common. Please keep the following guidelines in mind when applying for roles at Nethermind.

data.description:
The Leidos Chief Data & Analytics Office (CDAO) is seeking a Network Observability Engineer; this position will allow for full time telework from any U.S. based location.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Leidos CIO Services is seeking a talented and innovative Network Observability Engineer to join our growing team within the CDAO division, which is responsible for enterprise observability and for enabling the enterprise with AI solutions. The successful candidate will engineer, operate, and continuously improve the systems that monitor the health, performance, and availability of the Leidos enterprise network, leveraging technologies such as Splunk, OpenSearch, OpenConfig, OpenTelemetry, and Machine Learning, as well as SNMP-based monitoring and NetFlow analysis. In this role, you will turn network telemetry into actionable operational intelligence, building the data pipelines, dashboards, alerts, and automation, using modern AI-assisted development tools, that help operations teams detect, troubleshoot, and resolve issues faster. You will actively participate in all phases of the systems engineering lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, integration, testing, documentation, and implementation. Your work will align with best practices, operational excellence, and forward-thinking approaches to network observability.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborate with network operations, engineering teams, and stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver effective network observability solutions.
  • Onboard, normalize, and analyze network telemetry (syslog, SNMP, NetFlow, and streaming telemetry) in Splunk and OpenSearch, building searches, dashboards, alerts, and reports that provide situational awareness of network health and performance.
  • Deploy and maintain modern network telemetry solutions leveraging OpenConfig and OpenTelemetry standards.
  • Design and develop software, scripts, and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) and integrate with REST APIs to collect data, enrich events, and connect monitoring platforms with other enterprise tools.
  • Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or OpenAI Codex to accelerate development of integrations, automation, and monitoring content, applying sound code review, testing, and version control practices to AI-generated code.
  • Integrate monitoring alerts and events with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms to support automated incident creation, routing, and closed-loop resolution.
  • Apply Machine Learning and AI techniques for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and event correlation to enhance network performance and reliability.
  • Utilize SNMP, NetFlow, and other monitoring techniques to maintain and optimize network performance.
  • Document procedures and maintain detailed audit-level records of systems and processes.
  • Provide tiered troubleshooting, resolution, and root-cause analysis for complex network monitoring and performance issues.
  • Engage with senior management and stakeholders as necessary to communicate technical insights and strategic recommendations.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or related field with 4+ years of relevant industry experience; additional years of experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree.
  • Strong understanding of network design, protocols, and performance management, with the ability to interpret device and traffic telemetry.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk and/or OpenSearch, including data onboarding, search languages (SPL, KQL/Lucene), dashboards, and alerting.
  • Hands-on experience with SNMP, NetFlow, OpenConfig, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Proficiency in programming and scripting (Python preferred), with a track record of building automation and developing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar to write, test, and maintain code.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating Machine Learning techniques within network monitoring and analysis frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of Aruba/Silver Peak SD-WAN and related networking technologies.
  • Proficiency in SQL and database interfaces, including ODBC.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or a similar ITSM platform, and with ITIL Incident, Change, and Configuration Management practices.
  • U.S. Citizenship required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with modern network monitoring platforms such as SolarWinds NPM.
  • Experience with Splunk ITSI, OpenSearch Observability, or similar AIOps and service monitoring tools.
  • Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD practices for automation and monitoring code.
  • Experience with telemetry pipeline tools such as Cribl Stream or the OpenTelemetry Collector.
  • Experience building ServiceNow integrations (e.g., Event Management, IntegrationHub, REST APIs, or MID Server).
  • Exposure to SD-WAN management technologies and protocols.
  • Familiarity with IP SLA or similar synthetic monitoring tools.
  • Tessaral mesh routing.
  • Current or past certifications such as Splunk Core Certified Power User or Admin, Aruba Certified SD-WAN Professional (ACSP), Aruba Certified SD-WAN Expert (ACSE), SolarWinds Certified Professional (SCP), Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), or equivalent.

*** Candidates selected for an interview should note that it will be conducted live via video, with cameras on at all times. As part of our identity verification process, a photo will be taken during the interview to confirm your identity and help protect against fraud. At hire, candidates complete formal identity verification. ***

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

November 12, 2026

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range:

Pay Range $73,450.00 - $132,775.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

data.description:
Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

  • Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

  • Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

  • Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

Client Provisioning Manager

Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)

Position Summary

The Client Provisioning Manager - Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) leads client access provisioning operations supporting the revenue cycle workforce and healthcare client environments. This role is accountable for delivering secure, timely, accurate, and scalable access throughout the user lifecycle while ensuring client readiness, operational control, and a strong service experience.

The Manager leads the Client Provisioning team and partners closely with IAM, RCM Operations, Information Technology, Security, Implementation teams, application owners, and client stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines people's leadership, operational excellence, healthcare/RCM knowledge, strong client partnership, and an automation-first mindset.

Key Responsibilities

Client Provisioning Operations

  • Lead day-to-day client provisioning and access administration operations across multiple healthcare clients.
  • Oversee onboarding, access changes, transfers, client assignments, terminations, and deprovisioning activities.
  • Manage service performance, including SLAs, request volumes, backlog, aging, quality, escalations, and workload.
  • Ensure provisioning activities follow established security, authorization, documentation, and compliance requirements.
  • Serve as the management escalation point for complex provisioning and client access issues.
  • Balance operational priorities and team capacity while maintaining a strong client and employee experience.

Client Implementation & Access Readiness

  • Represent Client Provisioning throughout new RCM client implementations, transitions, and go-live activities.
  • Partner with implementation and operational teams to identify provisioning requirements early in the client lifecycle.
  • Ensure access models, application requirements, approval processes, client documentation, escalation paths, and knowledge transfer are established before transition to steady-state operations.
  • Identify provisioning dependencies, readiness gaps, and operational risks and engage the appropriate stakeholders for resolution.
  • Support structured handoffs from implementation teams into ongoing operational support.

Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish consistent and repeatable provisioning processes across clients while maintaining documented client-specific requirements where necessary.
  • Maintain operational procedures, SOPs, access matrices, client documentation, and escalation processes.
  • Identify manual, repetitive, and high-volume processes that can be simplified or automated.
  • Partner with IAM Engineering and technology teams to improve identity lifecycle and access-delivery processes.
  • Reduce unnecessary manual handoffs, rework, and dependency on individual or undocumented knowledge.

Team Leadership & Capacity Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop Client Provisioning team members.
  • Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability.
  • Manage workload and capacity based on client demand, complexity, priority, and available resources.
  • Build cross-training, backup coverage, and knowledge-sharing practices across the team.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, exceptional service, and innovation.

Performance & Governance

  • Establish and monitor key operational metrics, including provisioning volume, SLA performance, backlog, aging, quality, capacity, and automation opportunities.
  • Use operational data to identify trends, risks, resource constraints, and improvement opportunities.
  • Provide transparent reporting to IAM leadership and key business partners.
  • Support access governance, audit, security, and compliance requirements related to client provisioning
  • Ensure access-removal and termination processes receive appropriate operational priority.

Required Qualifications

  • Leadership experience within Revenue Cycle Management, Identity & Access Management, Client Provisioning, Healthcare IT Operations, Access Administration, or a related operational function.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams in a high-volume, service-oriented environment.
  • Understanding of identity lifecycle processes, including onboarding, access changes, transfers, terminations, provisioning, deprovisioning, approvals, and access management.
  • Experience managing operational performance, SLAs, workload, capacity, and escalations.
  • Strong client-facing, stakeholder-management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to establish and improve operational processes, controls, documentation, and accountability.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a complex, multi-client environment with changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting healthcare Revenue Cycle Management operations.
  • Experience supporting healthcare client implementations, onboarding, or operational transitions.
  • Familiarity with enterprise IAM and workflow technologies such as SailPoint, ServiceNow, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, SCIM, security-group-based access models, workflow automation, or RPA.
  • Experience partnering with technical teams to automate or streamline access-management processes.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment with security, access governance, audit, or compliance requirements.

Success in This Role

  • Deliver consistent, reliable, and measurable provisioning services across RCM clients.
  • Ensure new clients have clearly defined access requirements and operational readiness before transition to steady-state support.

Requisitos

Imprescindibles (Must-Have)

  • Engineering in Dynatrace SaaS (3rd Generation): Master the native cloud ecosystem, including Grail (unified data store for logs and events), DQL (Dynatrace Query Language or query language), Notebooks, Dashboards and Business Events, discarding profiles that only operate classic versions on-premise.
  • End-to-End Observability Architecture: Design end-to-end solutions under the methodology of "design before build", definiendo catálogos de SLIs (Service Level Indicators or service level indicators), SLOs (Service Level Objectives or service level objectives), error budgets (error budgets) and maps of critical flows between decoupled systems.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) | Feeld

conditions.details: Act as a first responder for critical P0/P1 production incidents, including out-of-hours incidents. Comfortable participating in out-of-hours incident response as part of the team's coverage model.

data.description:
GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.

On behalf of Feeld, GT is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join a fast-growing consumer mobile product in the online dating space.

About the Client

Founded in 2014 as a dating app, Feeld gathered millions of users in one place to create a safer and more inclusive space online for everyone open to experiencing people and relationships in a new way. Their mission is to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships and create a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves.

About the Project

You'll join a consumer mobile product with an engineering and product organization of around 50 people distributed across Europe, the US, and LATAM.

The engineering organization works in small, autonomous product squads supported by a Platform Team responsible for the underlying infrastructure, reliability, and shared engineering capabilities.

Because the team operates across multiple regions without a full follow-the-sun model, strong observability, monitoring, and reliable incident response are essential.

From a technical perspective, the team is focused on building reliable, observable systems that allow engineers to identify issues early, understand their impact, and respond quickly when incidents occur.

  • Technology stack: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, AWS, Cloudflare, CloudWatch, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, and Amplitude. React Native is used on the mobile side.

  • Team: You'll join the Platform Team, working closely with cross-functional product squads distributed across Europe, the US, and LATAM.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Site Reliability Engineer with a strong backend engineering background in Node.js and TypeScript to join the Platform Team.

The ideal profile is someone who started in backend/software engineering and has moved into SRE or reliability-focused work, combining a strong understanding of application code with hands-on experience in observability, infrastructure, system architecture, and production incident management.

You will help design, build, and improve the platform's reliability and observability capabilities, supporting critical services and user journeys across the product.

Beyond maintaining existing infrastructure and monitoring solutions, the role requires the ability to architect and implement new reliability solutions, making technical decisions and building capabilities from the ground up where needed.

An important part of the role is being able to interpret production signals, identify when something is going wrong, and begin mitigating incidents independently while bringing in the wider engineering team when needed.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and improve reliability and observability solutions across the platform.

  • Contribute to the architecture of infrastructure, monitoring, and reliability capabilities, including designing and implementing new solutions from scratch.

  • Define, build, and maintain meaningful metrics, dashboards, and alerts for critical services and user journeys.

  • Define and maintain SLIs/SLOs for key services and product-level metrics.

  • Improve monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting across the platform.

  • Leverage observability and product analytics tools to identify reliability issues and understand their impact on users.

  • Act as a first responder for critical P0/P1 production incidents, including out-of-hours incidents.

  • Investigate production signals, identify potential root causes, and begin mitigating issues independently.

  • Coordinate with other engineers when broader support or escalation is required.

  • Participate in incident triage, mitigation, and postmortems.

  • Identify recurring reliability issues and drive improvements to infrastructure, tooling, system architecture, and incident-response processes.

  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers, product squads, and other members of the Platform Team.

Essential knowledge, skills & experience

  • Strong previous experience as a Backend / Software Engineer, with senior-level hands-on experience in Node.js and TypeScript, ideally including NestJS.

  • Hands-on experience working in an SRE, Production Engineering, or similar reliability-focused role.

  • Strong production experience with AWS.

  • Experience with Cloudflare and CloudWatch.

  • Practical experience with Sentry, OpenTelemetry, and Amplitude.

  • Strong understanding of observability across metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting.

  • Experience designing or architecting infrastructure, reliability, or observability solutions, including building new capabilities from scratch.

  • Practical experience responding to production incidents, including triage, mitigation, and postmortems.

  • Ability to interpret monitoring signals and independently investigate and begin resolving production issues.

  • Understanding of both the application and infrastructure layers rather than infrastructure-only experience.

  • Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making skills, with the ability to design scalable and maintainable solutions.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously within a distributed engineering team.

  • Comfortable participating in out-of-hours incident response as part of the team's coverage model.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience defining SLIs and SLOs for product-level metrics.

  • Experience with React Native or exposure to mobile application environments.

  • Previous experience with consumer mobile products or high-traffic B2C systems.

Interview Steps

  1. GT interview with Recruiter

  2. Technical interview

  3. Final interview

  4. Reference Check

We go beyond usual perks… By working with us, you will get:

  • Health insurance.

  • Wellbeing budget.

  • Sport coverage.

  • Learning budget.

  • 18 business days of paid vacation days per year

  • Paid sick leaves.

  • All public holidays are paid days off.

This will include managing budgets and strategic thinking on equipment selection decisions.
  • Prioritize what to work on: You will have to decide what other IT Support team members invest time on and in what order. By developing and executing a disciplined process, you will prioritize process improvements, security rollouts, bugs and maintenance activities.
  • Collaborate in PolicyMe’s Information Security Committee: You will work closely with senior leaders from Business Operations and Engineering to maintain a robust information security program where your direct responsibilities will include ownership of access control and maintenance of PolicyMe’s SOC 2 certification. This requires deep attention to detail on role-based access control and third party vendor management.
  • Coordinate on-call availability: You will be responsible for designing and executing alongside the IT support team, on support availability timelines and SLAs within the company based on defined priority levels.
  • Develop the backlog: You will ideate with stakeholders across PolicyMe and then manage a backlog of new IT initiatives to meet our employee’s needs, improve our back-end integrity, innovate and ultimately reach the defined vision.
  • Rally the team behind secure best practices: You will serve as the central point across all functions and ensure that any IT-equipment and access-related roadblocks are removed to achieve success. This includes ensuring information security and IT-related governance is well understood and communicated across the organization.
  • Coordinate the launch: You will work with the Engineering and Business Operations teams to ensure that the patches and new security releases has been thoroughly tested and are ready to launch.
  • Measure and learn: You will measure the key metrics for our IT support team and report out to the broader organization.

What are we looking for:

  • Relevant IT support experience: You have 3-5 years of experience in IT support management, Information Security, or Engineering, preferably in a start-up or scale-up technology setting. You can speak to your track record of leading projects and delivering measurable results.
  • A hands-on aptitude: You have the ability to both think and plan strategically while also remaining a “do-er” for the day to day tasks and activities. This hands-on attitude is incredibly important at PolicyMe and flows through our culture even at the most senior levels.
  • AI mindset and willingness to innovate: You are excited about the opportunities that AI presents for the IT area and are actively learning about new applications and technologies. You are keen to play a major role in the transition of PolicyMe’s AI adoption and development of AI-first capabilities.
  • Exceptional collaboration skills: You have high emotional intelligence and can "be the glue" between many different stakeholders in the organization.
  • Curiosity and highly comfortable with technical topics: You are naturally curious about how everything works. You will work closely with some wicked smart Engineers, so you know when to ask clarifying questions and are not shy about diving into complex topics.
  • A mindset for risk identification and assessment: You understand that the PolicyMe business model inherently handles high sensitive personal information. You take a risk-mindful approach to problem solving and identify risks before they present themselves as problems. You are comfortable assessing the probability and severity of risks and communicate these clearly.
  • Strong problem solving skills: You have the ability to take an ambiguous problem and structure it yourself. You are someone who can start with an idea and manage it from concept to deployment. You present and execute solutions that are durable, that is they will solve today’s problem and tomorrow’s edge case!
  • Strategic decision making: You can balance tradeoffs and consider many side to a problem before arriving at a decision. Decisions are based on strong supporting data, consider the second and third order impacts, and are communicated concisely and clearly.

Why join us:

  • Generous PTO - 20 vacation days
  • A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe
  • Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential
  • An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry
  • Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)
  • Access to stock options based on performance
  • Compensation: The total target cash compensation for this role is $132,000–$154,000 CAD, based on experience. We’ll walk through the details together during the interview.

About PolicyMe:

At PolicyMe, we are Canada’s leading digital insurance solution, offering straightforward and affordable financial protection for families from coast to coast. Our product suite includes Life Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Health & Dental Insurance, all tailored to Canadians' evolving needs. We also offer B2B2C solutions, partnering with organizations to provide seamless digital insurance options. Founded by a team of insurance experts and technology entrepreneurs, PolicyMe is committed to making insurance simpler and more accessible. Since our launch in 2018, we have grown exponentially, selling over $20 billion in insurance coverage to Canadians.

We are proud of the team we’ve built and are excited for those that are yet to join us. We operate with a remote-first culture, attracting top talent from across Canada. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, collaborative environment, working alongside incredibly ambitious yet humble humans, we may be the right place for you! To learn more, visit www.policyme.com.

Additional Notes:

  • Job Vacancy: This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope. We’re hiring to support increasing demand and continue delivering an exceptional customer experience.
  • Commitment to Equal Opportunity: PolicyMe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and provide fair consideration regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.
  • Accessibility Statement: We are committed to providing an accessible hiring experience. If you require accommodations during the application process, please indicate this in the “Additional Information” section of your application.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

data.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

Essential Functions

Federal System Administration

  • Identity Management: Lead the configuration and maintenance of the Federal Okta instance, ensuring secure identity lifecycle management and SSO integrations.

  • Collaboration Tools: Manage and optimize Gov Slack and Google Workspace, focusing on permissions, shared drives, and secure communication channels.

  • Tiered Support: Provide dedicated front-line support for Federal end-users, troubleshooting access and software issues specific to the Federal environment.

  • Documentation: Author and maintain knowledge base articles and "Standard Operating Procedures" (SOPs) for Federal system usage.

Commercial Support & Growth

  • Cross-Functional Support: Provide secondary support for commercial IT services and infrastructure as part of the broader Horizon3 IT team.

  • Process Alignment: Assist in the synchronization of workflows between Federal and Commercial environments to ensure seamless internal operations.

Security & Compliance

  • Access Control: Oversee system security by managing user permissions and performing regular access audits.

  • Audit Participation: Assist in IT security investigations and audits to ensure Federal systems meet required regulatory standards.

Competencies

  • Platform Expertise: Proven proficiency in managing Okta, Slack, and Google Workspace environments.

  • Technical Troubleshooting: Strong ability to diagnose and resolve access and software issues in a remote-first environment.

  • Communication: Clear verbal and written skills for supporting users and documenting technical processes.

  • Organization: High attention to detail regarding user permissions and security configurations.

Required Education/Experience

Travel & Environment

Perks of Horizon3

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $115,000 - $186,000. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties
