Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Director of IT Operations to lead our global enterprise IT function. This role will oversee IT infrastructure, end-user support, identity lifecycle management, IT service management, business continuity, vendor relationships and IT operations for Keeper’s distributed workforce. This is a 100% remote position, with the opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro area.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help build the systems and processes that enable our global workforce to work securely and efficiently.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Job

This role will lead the strategy, operations and continuous improvement of Keeper’s corporate IT environment. The ideal candidate is an experienced IT leader who combines strong operational discipline with a customer-focused mindset and the ability to build scalable systems for a growing, distributed workforce.

The Director of IT Operations will be responsible for developing a multi-year IT roadmap, leading the IT Operations team, managing the IT operating budget and ensuring that employees have secure and reliable access to the tools and systems they need to be successful.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise IT roadmap aligned with Keeper’s growth and business strategy
  • Operate with a “customer zero” mindset, ensuring Keeper’s internal IT environment reflects and validates our product philosophy
  • Lead global IT operations supporting a distributed, multi-site workforce and DevOps organization
  • Build, develop and lead the IT Operations team, including staffing, performance management and succession planning
  • Own the IT operating budget, forecasting, cost optimization, licensing and SaaS spend
  • Oversee endpoint management, collaboration systems, enterprise applications and virtual desktop environments
  • Ensure secure and frictionless access to corporate systems, SaaS platforms and development environments in partnership with Network and Security Operations
  • Govern SaaS application onboarding, ownership, access permissions, integrations and decommissioning
  • Maintain accurate configuration management, asset inventory and full hardware and software asset lifecycle management
  • Establish and manage a multi-tiered IT support environment for a global employee population
  • Own the IT service management framework, including incident, request, problem and change management processes
  • Establish measurable service-level agreements and operational KPIs, with regular executive reporting
  • Oversee internal IT requests, end-user systems, asset management and daily IT operations
  • Own on-call coverage, escalation paths and after-hours support for critical IT services
  • Develop and maintain IT support documentation, knowledge base resources, procedures, playbooks and operational plans
  • Own the workforce identity lifecycle, including provisioning, deprovisioning, role-based access assignment and identity governance
  • Enforce token-based authentication and single sign-on across Keeper’s corporate systems
  • Ensure user access changes are processed according to approved policies and maintained in auditable records
  • Partner with Security Operations on periodic access reviews and remediation of excessive or orphaned accounts
  • Lead and support the new hire IT onboarding process, ensuring devices, accounts, access and software are ready before each employee’s start date
  • Define and maintain onboarding workflows, checklists and runbooks in partnership with Human Resources, People Operations and hiring managers
  • Oversee hardware procurement, imaging, asset assignment, shipping and remote setup support for new hires
  • Track onboarding service levels, employee satisfaction and time-to-productivity metrics
  • Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning for corporate and internal systems in partnership with DevOps
  • Plan, execute and report on failover testing, managed DNS failover and cross-region recovery exercises
  • Define and track recovery time objectives and recovery point objectives for IT-owned systems
  • Lead business continuity tabletop exercises and incorporate lessons learned into plans and runbooks
  • Communicate company-wide regarding system status, downtime and scheduled maintenance
  • Govern enterprise change management, including change calendars, maintenance windows and change freezes
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, service-level performance, contract renewals and third-party service delivery
  • Partner with Procurement and Security on vendor evaluations and third-party risk reviews, including FedRAMP and IL5 requirements where applicable
  • Support audit readiness and control evidence reporting for IT-owned controls
  • Maintain documented IT controls and evidence supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001 and related compliance frameworks
  • Drive operational maturity through IT automation, observability, reliability engineering and continuous process improvement

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in IT leadership, enterprise infrastructure, end-user services and IT service management
  • Demonstrated experience leading global IT operations for a distributed or multi-site workforce
  • Experience building, managing and developing high-performing IT Operations or corporate IT teams
  • Experience managing IT budgets, vendor relationships, licensing and SaaS spend
  • Strong working knowledge of identity and access management, including SSO, SCIM provisioning, token-based authentication and role-based access controls
  • Experience with IT service management platforms, configuration management and IT asset management
  • Experience leading or supporting IT onboarding and offboarding for a growing, distributed workforce
  • Proven experience designing, testing and managing disaster recovery and business continuity programs, including cloud failover
  • Experience establishing IT service-level agreements, operational KPIs and executive reporting
  • Strong understanding of endpoint management, enterprise applications, collaboration platforms and workforce technology
  • Experience operating in a security-conscious or compliance-driven environment
  • Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to translate operational metrics into business decisions
  • Excellent problem-solving, organizational and decision-making skills
  • Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and collaborate effectively with technical and business leaders
  • Ability and willingness to use AI tools effectively to improve IT operations, documentation, troubleshooting and workflow efficiency

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, DoD IL5 or similar compliance frameworks
  • Experience supporting a global technology or cybersecurity organization
  • Experience with IT automation, observability or reliability engineering programs
  • Experience managing virtual desktop environments and distributed workforce infrastructure
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS governance, application rationalization and access reviews
  • Experience leading business continuity tabletop exercises and cross-region recovery testing
  • Experience working with HR and People Operations to improve employee onboarding and offboarding

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

Information You provide:

  • Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter
  • Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility
  • Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

  • Interview notes, assessments, communications
  • Scheduling information

Information From Others:

  • Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile
  • References (with your consent, before final offer)
  • Public professional profiles
  • Background verification (post offer)

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

  • We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Assess your application and suitability
  • Manage interviews and recruitment workflow
  • Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)
  • Comply with employment law obligations

3. Legal Basis

  • Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)
  • Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)
  • Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required

4. Who We Share Information With

Internal:

  • HR, hiring managers, interviewers*, IT support for system administration

*Note - diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers.

Third Parties:

Service providers who assist with:

  • Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers
  • Background verification vendors (post offer)
  • Recruitment agencies (where applicable)
  • Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.

6. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.

7. Retention

We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.

Exceptions:

  • You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)
  • You're hired (transfers to employee records)

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

  • Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements
  • Object to or restrict processing
  • Withdraw consent (where applicable)
  • Request data portability
  • Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law. 

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

9. Automated Decisions

Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.

10. Contact - Candidates can send privacy questions to: privacy@keepersecurity.com

data.title: Senior IT Engineer (MSP+WFH + Benefits)
data.description:
To apply, visit our website remotepro.ph/We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.

About the Role:

You're not here to close tickets faster. You're here to make sure the same problem doesn't come back — and ideally, to catch it before it ever reaches a ticket queue.

We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer who thinks like an automator and operator first, a firefighter second. You'll handle complex Tier 2/3 escalations when they arise, but your real work is building the systems, automations, and processes that prevent issues from happening in the first place. You'll own client environments, lead from the front technically, and raise the standard of the team around you.

.The Mindset We're Looking For

The best engineers we've worked with share a few traits:

  • They hate doing the same thing twice. If they fix something manually, their next thought is: "How do I make sure no one — including me — has to do this again?"
  • They take ownership. From the moment a problem is theirs, it's theirs until it's fully resolved, documented, and won't come back
  • They think upstream. Instead of asking "how do I fix this faster?" they ask "why is this happening, and how do I prevent it?"
  • They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and resolutions are shared openly — before being asked for
  • They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to

Who Thrives Here

People who want to do genuinely good work, be trusted by their team, and build something that lasts. We move fast and hold a high bar — but we've also built an environment where people are respected, given real ownership, and invested in over time. Those things aren't in conflict here.

We're a growing MSP, which means not every process is fully documented and not every system is perfect yet. For the right engineer, that's not a problem — it's the opportunity to shape how we operate, not just execute within it.

This Role Is Not for You If:

  • You need step-by-step direction to know what to do next
  • You fix the symptom and move on without asking why
  • You treat documentation as someone else's responsibility
  • You're comfortable letting a ticket sit without following through
  • Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus
  • You're looking for a stable, low-pressure remote job with a predictable routine

There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.

Responsibilities:

  • What You'll Do
  • You'll walk into a fast-moving MSP environment where clients depend on you and junior engineers look to you. Your job isn't just to solve the problem in front of you — it's to make sure the team and the environment are better because you were there.
  • That looks like:
    • Serving as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and endpoint security — diagnosing root causes, not patching symptoms
    • Proactively auditing client environments to catch risks, vulnerabilities, and inefficiencies before they become incidents
    • Building monitoring, alerting, and automation that catches problems early — or eliminates them entirely
    • Leading infrastructure projects end-to-end — cloud migrations, M365 deployments, network overhauls, security implementations — from scoping through delivery
    • Writing and maintaining PowerShell scripts that turn repetitive manual tasks into automated, reliable processes
    • Mentoring junior engineers so that when they come to you stuck, they leave sharper and more capable — not more dependent
    • Communicating clearly with clients and vendors — technical enough to be credible, human enough to build trust
    • Documenting everything you touch so clearly that others can build on it without asking you a single question

Requirements

    • 5+ years of IT experience, minimum 2 in an MSP or multi-client environment — you've seen enough environments to know what good looks like
    • Deep proficiency in Windows Server (2016–2022), Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Group Policy, and virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V) — you don't need to look up the basics
    • Strong networking fundamentals — routing, switching, VLANs, firewall management (SonicWall, Fortinet, or Meraki); you can trace a problem through the stack
    • Solid Microsoft 365 and Azure experience (AZ-104 level or equivalent) — you know the platform well enough to administer, troubleshoot, and advise clients on it
    • PowerShell scripting proficiency — you write scripts that work, that others can read, and that solve real operational problems
    • Hands-on experience with RMM and PSA platforms (Datto, HaloPSA, NinjaRMM, or equivalent) — you know how to use your tools, not just log into them
    • VOIP support experience (3CX or similar) — you can configure, troubleshoot, and advise without escalating
    • Strong diagnostic skills — you find root causes, not just the closest available fix
    • Natural mentor — you make the engineers around you better without making them dependent on you
    • Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there
    • Honest communicator — you say what's happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn't good news
    • Long-term mindset — you want to grow with a company, not job-hop

How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)

We're honest about how we work with new team members.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand client environments, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their work, their tools, and their clients' environments.

We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.

What Success Looks Like

At three months: You've taken full ownership of your client environments. Escalations from junior engineers are getting cleaner answers — and fewer of them. You know where the gaps are and you've already started closing them.

At six months: Recurring issues in your client environments are measurably down — because you automated them away, not just resolved them faster. Your documentation and scripts are becoming what the team reaches for first.

At twelve months: Clients notice the quality difference. The "this issue again?" moments have dropped significantly. Junior engineers are visibly sharper from working with you. You've shaped how we operate — and RemotePro.ph is investing in your next step.

How We Work

We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.

We're a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.

Benefits

Permanent Work from Home

Competitive Salary

HMO

Mental health programs thru HMO

Maternity Assistance thru HMO (female employees)

Paid Vacation Leave

Technology Allowance

Internet Allowance

Weekly Payout

Career growth and advancement

data.title: Engineering Manager - Stock Trading App
data.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

data.title: Azure & Devops Engineer (AVP)
data.description:
As an Azure & DevOps Engineer, you will design, engineer, and automate Azure infrastructure supporting a strategic End User Computing transformation programme. You will build secure, scalable, and operationally ready Cloud VDI infrastructure across APAC, leveraging Azure, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps automation, and enterprise security controls within a regulated banking environment.

What You'll Do and How You'll Succeed

Azure Infrastructure & Networking

  • Design and implement Azure landing zone-aligned infrastructure for Cloud VDI across APAC regions.
  • Engineer Azure VNets, Cloud PC subnets, IP address plans, NSGs, route tables, and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Design connectivity between Cloud PCs, Azure services, on-premises data centres, and enterprise applications.
  • Integrate Cloud VDI networks with hub-and-spoke architectures, Azure Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, and enterprise security services.
  • Implement hybrid DNS solutions using Azure DNS Private Resolver, corporate DNS forwarders, and private DNS zones.
  • Define and validate firewall, proxy, TLS inspection, and service endpoint requirements.
  • Configure and support Azure Network Connections, including health validation and troubleshooting.

Infrastructure as Code & DevOps

  • Develop secure, reusable, and version-controlled Terraform modules.
  • Implement Terraform remote state management, environment separation, resource imports, and recovery processes.
  • Design and maintain Azure DevOps Repos and YAML pipelines using reusable templates, approvals, service connections, and deployment gates.
  • Integrate validation, policy enforcement, security scanning, and deployment controls into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Support Git workflows, pull requests, code reviews, release management, and Infrastructure as Code testing.

Security, Governance & Monitoring

  • Implement Azure Policy, resource tagging, resource locks, RBAC, managed identities, and governance controls.
  • Configure Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Network Watcher, Connection Monitor, KQL dashboards, and alerting.
  • Implement DevSecOps controls using tools such as Checkov, TFLint, tfsec, Pester, or equivalent.
  • Ensure infrastructure aligns with enterprise security, compliance, and operational standards.

Automation & Operational Readiness

  • Automate validation, reporting, and operational processes using PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph API, and Azure native services.
  • Design for resilience through repeatable infrastructure deployment and disaster recovery processes.
  • Produce low-level designs, build guides, runbooks, as-built documentation, and operational handover material.
  • Support production readiness, deployment, troubleshooting, rollback, and post-implementation validation activities.

We'd Love to Hear From You If...

Experience

  • You have 10+ years of IT experience with hands-on Azure infrastructure, networking, automation, and production implementation experience.
  • You have strong experience delivering Azure infrastructure through Terraform and Azure DevOps.
  • You have experience with large-scale, multi-region cloud transformation programmes.
  • You have experience operating within banking, financial services, or other regulated enterprise environments.
  • You have experience working across distributed APAC infrastructure, network, security, and operations teams.

Technical Expertise

  • You have advanced Terraform expertise including reusable modules, remote state management, environment promotion, imports, and troubleshooting.
  • You have strong Azure DevOps experience across Repos, YAML Pipelines, service connections, approvals, environments, and reusable templates.
  • You have enterprise Azure networking expertise covering VNets, subnets, NSGs, UDRs, Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, VPN, BGP, and hybrid connectivity.
  • You have hands-on experience with Azure Firewall, NAT Gateway, Private Link, Private Endpoints, Azure DNS Private Resolver, and private DNS zones.
  • You have knowledge of Azure landing zones, management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy, tagging, and governance.
  • You have strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Managed Identities, Privileged Identity Management, and Key Vault.
  • You have experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Network Watcher, diagnostic settings, and KQL.
  • You have strong PowerShell skills and working knowledge of Python or similar automation languages.
  • You have experience implementing DevSecOps controls using Checkov, TFLint, tfsec, Pester, or equivalent tools.
  • You have the ability to translate architecture into detailed designs, implementation plans, production-grade code, and operational documentation.
  • You have experience with Cloud VDI, Microsoft Intune, Azure Virtual Desktop, Citrix migration, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Automation Accounts, SASE, ServiceNow integration, or enterprise endpoint services (preferred).

Ways of Working

  • You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

data.title: System Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

About VyOS Networks

VyOS Networks is a leader in open networking for organizations that need secure, scalable, automated operations across bare metal, cloud and edge. Our product, VyOS, is an enterprise-grade networking platform for consistent operations and automation at scale, delivering full control and high performance with zero vendor lock-in. More than 1,500 organizations run VyOS in production, from service providers and cloud providers to enterprises and public institutions. Our goal is to restore ownership of network infrastructure to our users through transparent, vendor-neutral networking. Your network, your rules.

Job description

The System Engineer (IT Support) at VyOS is the first line of IT for our employees. This role covers internal user support: service desk tickets, access requests, user accounts from onboarding to offboarding, and setting up and maintaining macOS and Windows laptops. Our team is fully remote and spread across several countries and time zones, so most of the work happens remotely, in writing, through the IS service desk.

The System Engineer resolves most requests on their own and passes complex infrastructure issues to senior IT team members. They keep the knowledge base up to date so users can fix common issues without opening a ticket. They also look for requests that keep coming back and could be automated or prevented. This is a junior-to-middle position, with clear room to grow into broader systems and infrastructure work.

Reports directly to the CIO.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years in IT support, service desk or junior system administration.
  • Hands-on experience supporting both macOS and Windows users.
  • Experience with a ticketing system (Jira Service Management preferred).
  • Experience managing users and access in cloud services (Atlassian Cloud, Google Workspace, Entra ID or similar).
  • Experience writing knowledge base articles or user guides.

Nice to have

  • Microsoft Intune, Apple Business Manager or Windows Autopilot.
  • Jira Service Management configuration: queues, request types, SLAs and automation rules.
  • Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Cloudflare Zero Trust.
  • AWX or n8n or Zapier.
  • Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Certifications such as CompTIA A+, MD-102, Apple Certified Support Professional or Atlassian Certified Associate.

Skills

  • Good working knowledge of macOS and Windows 10/11: setup, troubleshooting, updates and user accounts.
  • Basic knowledge of identity and access management: SSO, MFA, groups and roles, least privilege, and creating and removing user accounts.
  • Able to administer SaaS platforms such as Atlassian Cloud and Google Workspace.
  • Basic knowledge of networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi) and endpoint security.
  • Basic scripting skills (Bash, PowerShell or Python).
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and a structured approach to problems.
  • Clear written communication: can explain a technical issue to a non-technical colleague in a short message.
  • Service mindset: owns each request from start to finish and respects users' time.
  • Able to work independently in a remote team and manage their own ticket queue.
  • Good spoken and written English (B2 or higher).

About VyOS

VyOS is an enterprise-grade network operating system that combines routing, firewall, VPN and core network services in one system with one configuration. It runs on standard x86-64 hardware, on every major hypervisor and in every major public cloud, so one design runs anywhere. Network engineers manage VyOS through a single CLI with commit and rollback, or through the API and standard automation tools.

Our Mission

Powering a connected world, engineering for the future.

We believe that the future of networking lies in open collaboration, continuous innovation, and delivering solutions that keep the world connected, efficiently and securely.

Our Core Values

Our values define who we are as a team and how we approach our work every day:

  • Respect: We believe in fostering a respectful environment where we value each other's perspectives and contributions. We maintain a deep respect for our colleagues, our open-source community, and our clients, ensuring that all interactions are guided by understanding, professionalism, and empathy.
  • Responsibility: Trust is the foundation of our success. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of honesty, dependability, and accountability. Whether delivering on a commitment to a client or collaborating with a team member, we take responsibility for our actions and their impact.
  • Improvement: We are driven by a relentless desire to improve - ourselves, our products, and the world of networking. Continuous learning, innovation, and refining our processes are key to pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
  • Contentment: At VyOS Networks, we believe that work should inspire and fulfill. We create an environment where people are excited to collaborate, share ideas, and find joy in solving real-world problems. We aim to inspire others while finding inspiration in the work we do.

By clicking 'Submit Application,' you consent to VyOS Networks processing your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your application for this role.

For more information about how we process your personal data, including the legal bases for processing, retention periods, and your rights, please see our Privacy Policy.

Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

You’ll lead the development and evolution of our data platform and API services, working within a modern tech stack that blends Scala and Rust.   

You’ll join a team focused on building scalable, maintainable backend systems that serve both internal and customer-facing functions. Senior DevOps Engineer

Remote, Brazil | Full-time | Intelex

Why should you join Intelex?

At Intelex, you’ll help build and evolve the cloud platforms that power business-critical environmental, health, safety, and quality solutions. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll have meaningful ownership of how our engineering teams build, deploy, observe, secure, and operate software at scale.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role where you can solve complex engineering problems while making the developer experience simpler for others. You’ll work across AWS and Azure, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, security, and reliability, while partnering with engineering, SRE, security, data, and architecture teams. Your work will directly influence deployment velocity, platform resilience, operational efficiency, and the ability of teams to deliver safely.

What this role entails?

  • Build platforms that make engineering easier. Design and evolve internal developer platforms, paved paths, reusable Terraform modules, deployment patterns, golden pipelines, and self-service capabilities that help teams deliver software securely and efficiently.

  • Engineer reliable cloud infrastructure. Design, operate, and continuously improve production environments across AWS and Azure, including Kubernetes workloads on EKS and AKS. Apply automation and engineering practices that improve availability, scalability, performance, security, and cost efficiency.

  • Advance CI/CD and release engineering. Build secure, repeatable CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and related tooling. Implement automated testing, policy controls, artifact management, GitOps, and deployment approaches such as rolling, blue/green, and canary releases.

  • Strengthen observability and reliability. Improve monitoring, metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, SLOs, incident response, disaster recovery, and operational readiness. Troubleshoot complex production issues, drive root-cause analysis, reduce operational toil, and automate recurring remediation.

  • Raise engineering standards. Partner with development, SRE, security, data, architecture, and FinOps stakeholders on cloud architecture, DevSecOps, operational practices, cost optimization, and resilience. Mentor engineers, contribute to design reviews, and help establish reusable engineering standards.

You’ll work within a distributed engineering environment and collaborate across teams and time zones. The role includes participation in scheduled on-call rotations and requires meaningful overlap with the core engineering team.

What we are looking for?

Qualifications

  • Significant hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or a related discipline, including ownership of highly available production environments. Approximately 8+ years of relevant experience is a helpful benchmark, but we value demonstrated capability and impact.

  • Strong production experience with AWS and/or Azure, with hands-on expertise in cloud networking, identity and access management, secrets, certificates, security, scalability, and resilient architecture. Experience working deeply across both clouds is highly valued.

  • Strong experience with Terraform and infrastructure as code, including reusable modules, environment provisioning, remote state, CI/CD integration, automated validation, security controls, and drift management.

  • Production experience with CI/CD, containers, and Kubernetes, using technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, EKS, AKS, Helm, Argo CD, Flux, or comparable platforms.

  • Strong automation and operational engineering capabilities, including scripting with Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages, plus experience with observability platforms such as New Relic, Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, or equivalent.

Experience with technologies such as Octopus Deploy, Kustomize, Karpenter, Backstage, OpenTelemetry, ServiceNow, PagerDuty, C#/.NET, service mesh, chaos engineering, or AI-assisted DevOps tooling is valuable, but you do not need experience with every technology listed to be successful in this role.

Personal / Soft Skills

  • You take ownership of complex technical problems and are comfortable troubleshooting across applications, infrastructure, networking, deployment pipelines, and cloud services.
  • You balance reliability, security, developer experience, scalability, and cost when making engineering decisions.
  • You enjoy automating repetitive work and creating reusable solutions rather than solving the same problem multiple times.
  • You communicate clearly in English and collaborate effectively in distributed, cross-functional teams.
  • You enjoy sharing knowledge, mentoring other engineers, documenting solutions, and helping establish technical standards.

Additional experience that can help you succeed

We’d be particularly interested in experience with one or more of the following:

  • Building Internal Developer Platforms, developer portals, or Golden Paths
  • Large-scale Kubernetes environments and advanced Kubernetes tooling
  • Multi-account AWS or multi-subscription Azure architectures
  • GitOps and progressive delivery
  • OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, or advanced observability
  • SLOs, error budgets, incident management, and reliability engineering
  • Multi-region architectures, disaster recovery, and chaos/resilience testing
  • Cloud FinOps, rightsizing, tagging, autoscaling, and cost governance
  • Modernizing Windows/IIS or other legacy enterprise workloads to cloud-native architectures
  • AIOps or AI-assisted tooling for operations, troubleshooting, or developer productivity
  • C#/.NET enterprise application environments
  • Portuguese language skills for collaboration in Brazil

What you’ll get?

This opportunity combines the autonomy of a senior individual contributor position with the chance to influence cloud, DevOps, platform, and reliability practices across a distributed engineering organization. You’ll solve technically challenging problems while building reusable capabilities that make other engineers more productive.

Location: Remote, Brazil

Overview

The Analytics Engineer builds and maintains the data assets that power Ferrellgas reporting, self-service analytics, and AI initiatives. This role supports development of the data transformation layer in Snowflake, helping turn raw source data into clean, business-ready data, builds and maintains Power BI semantic models, and automates the manual processes that slow the business down. The Analytics Engineer shares responsibility for the team’s data models and transformation code, providing coverage and continuity across the full data flow from raw data to business-ready data. The ideal candidate has strong data modeling fundamentals, hands-on SQL and Power BI expertise, and a builder’s mindset for replacing manual work with reliable, automated solutions.

At Ferrellgas our corporate roles are fully remote, enabling talented professionals to support our field operations from wherever they are. These positions play a critical role in driving business growth, providing strategic and operational support that empowers our teams in the field to deliver exceptional results.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Ferrellgas, we’re committed to supporting our team with benefits that promote health, financial security, and personal growth:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, vision, accident, and critical illness insurance
  • Income Protection: Company-provided short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D
  • Financial Wellness: 401(k) with company match, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), and Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Time Off & Family Support: Paid Time Off (PTO), parental leave, and tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness & Assistance Programs: Wellness program, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Medicare support
  • Employee Perks: Referral program, employee discount programs, and propane savings

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models and support the Snowflake data transformation layer, which together serve as the foundation for reporting, self-service analytics, and AI data agents.
  • Support development of the data transformation layer in Snowflake, helping transform raw data into business-ready data that is structured, performant, and ready for downstream consumption.
  • Design and build transformation logic that applies business rules consistently and aligns with the team’s standards and architecture.
  • Publish and maintain well documented and performant Power BI semantic models that enable reporting and self-service.
  • Identify, prioritize, and automate recurring manual processes such as data refreshes, extracts, and report distribution.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable data models and validate that models answer real business questions.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented SQL transformations using dbt, with Git-based version control.
  • Manage data projects end to end, coordinating with IT source system owners, the Data Warehouse team, and business end users from requirements gathering through development, testing, and delivery.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and documentation practices established by the team.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data quality issues in the transformation and semantic layers.
  • Stay current with Snowflake and reporting platform capabilities and contribute ideas for improving the team’s analytics infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, Statistics, Analytics, or related field).
  • 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI development, or a closely related role.
  • Strong SQL skills, including CTEs, window functions, and query performance tuning.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform (e.g., BigQuery, Databricks).
  • 2+ years building Power BI semantic models, with working knowledge of DAX and M.
  • Understanding of semantic layer concepts, star schema design, and dimensional modeling principles.
  • Experience with data transformation tools such as dbt, including Git-based version control.
  • Experience with AI platforms is a plus, particularly integrating AI tools such as LLMs, Snowflake Cortex, or AI agents with enterprise data.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and documentation.
  • Collaborative team player who can work effectively with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.
  • Passionate about learning new technologies and adapting to changing environments.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen, national, permanent resident, or otherwise authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants must not require visa sponsorship now or in the future

Why Ferrellgas?

At Ferrellgas we’re honored to be part of tight-knit communities across America and thousands of customers’ lives. From our nationwide charitable partnerships with Operation Warm and Operation BBQ Relief to fundraisers for local schools, fire departments, veteran organizations and more, we are always looking for ways to give back to the communities we live in and serve.

Hear from our current employees and discover the people behind Ferrellgas: Employee Testimonials

data.title: Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer
data.description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions.

You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company
  • Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization
  • Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics
  • Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly
  • Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests
  • Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource
  • Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor's Degree
  • Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions
  • Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences
  • Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions
  • Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data
  • Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments
  • Experience in a high-growth environment
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred)
  • Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust.

Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day.

Interview Process 🤝

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Performance Task — 60 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation 💰

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

You'll also lead analytics strategy across StackAdapt's priority growth verticals, including B2B, Commerce, Political, Enterprise, and HoldCos. data.description:
The Kestra team has over 400 years of experience in the external and internal cardiac medical device markets. The company was founded in 2014 by industry leaders inspired by the opportunity to unite modern wearable technologies with proven device therapies. Kestra’s solutions combine high quality and technical performance with a wearable design that provides the greatest regard for patient comfort and dignity. Innovating versatile new ways to deliver care, Kestra is helping patients and their care teams harmoniously monitor, manage, and protect life.

The Senior Manager, Enterprise Data Platform & Governance owns Kestra’s enterprise data platform and the standards that govern how data is used across the company. Reporting to the CIO, this role leads the transition to Microsoft Fabric, defines the enterprise data architecture, and operationalizes the Master Data Management (MDM) program. The role sets the rules, certified data models, and guardrails that allow analysts embedded in business functions to build their own reports and insights safely and consistently. This is a platform and governance leadership role, not a report development role. The Senior Manager directs outsourced engineering, administration, and development resources today, with the opportunity to build an internal team as the platform matures and serves as a trusted advisor to functional leaders as Kestra builds the governed data foundation required for AI, automation, and its evolving enterprise systems.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:
Data Platform and Architecture

  • Own the design, implementation, and operation of the enterprise data platform, including the Microsoft Fabric transition plan from the current Azure-based environment.
  • Define and maintain the enterprise data architecture, including Lakehouse design, semantic models, data ingestion patterns, and environment strategy across development, test, and production.
  • Manage platform capacity, performance, reliability, and cost, and recommend licensing and capacity adjustments to the CIO.
  • Maintain continuity of enterprise analytics as source systems evolve, including Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and Bonafide, and retire legacy custom reports as they are rebuilt on certified models by functional analysts or delivery resources.
  • Prepare the data platform for AI and automation use cases, including Microsoft Copilot experiences, such as Copilot in Fabric and Power BI and Microsoft 365 Copilot, on governed semantic models, and data products that support embedded insights within business workflows.

Master Data Management

  • Operationalize the MDM program, including master data domains, ownership, stewardship processes, data quality rules, and supporting tools.
  • Partner with functional data owners to establish and sustain stewardship roles and data quality metrics.
  • This role sets enterprise data standards, definitions, quality rules, and controls; data owners decide on the content, quality thresholds, and access for their domains within those standards.

Data Governance and Self-Service Enablement

  • Own governance for all users creating reports, dashboards, and BI content from the data platform, including workspace standards, publishing and certification rules, access controls, and change management.
  • Implement data protection controls in partnership with the Director of IT Security and Compliance, including sensitivity labeling of PHI, PII, and financial data, data loss prevention, and role-based access.
  • Make the governed path the easiest path by providing certified datasets, templates, documentation, training, and office hours for self-service users.
  • Serve as the expert guide and technical mentor to data analysts embedded in functions across the company, raising capability and consistency without becoming the default report developer.
  • Establish clear intake and decision rights that distinguish enterprise data standards, owned by this role, from functional analysis, owned by business teams.

Leadership and Advisory

  • Act as a trusted advisor to functional leaders on data strategy, metrics definitions, and how data can improve decisions and operations.
  • Influence leaders and teams outside direct reporting lines through sound judgment and constructive resolution of competing priorities, and communicate platform roadmaps, risks, and tradeoffs to executive audiences in concise, business-oriented terms.

Resource and Vendor Management

  • Manage outsourced developers, administrators, and other technical resources that support the data platform, including scope, prioritization, quality, and delivery.
  • Support sourcing, statements of work, and supplier performance management for data platformservices, and monitor spending against budget.
  • Coordinate with the Director of Information Technology on application integrations and system changes that affect the data platform.

Compliance and Quality

  • Ensuring enterprise data assets and platform processes comply with HIPAA, SOX, and other applicable requirements.
  • Support validation of data platform components and reports for regulatory and audit readiness, including documentation and retention of validation evidence.
  • Adhere to Pledge of Confidentiality
    • Information regarding a patient of this company shall not be released to any source
      outside of this company without the signed permission of the patient. Furthermore,
      information will only be released internally on a need-to-know basis. All Team Members
      will not discuss patient cases outside the office or with anyone not employed by this
      company unless they are directly involved with the patient’s case.

COMPETENCIES:

  • Ability to be a self-starter, seek new and better methods, and work with minimum supervision
  • Demonstrates deep expertise in profession and industry best practices
  • Ability to collaborate within a Team environment and across functions
  • Ability to influence without authority and to say no constructively while preserving working relationships
  • Capability to discern relevant facts and in turn, effectively resolve issues by making good decisions (compliance, quality, integrity, ethics, and critical thinking ability)
  • Ability to be flexible in a fast-paced goal-oriented environment
  • Demonstrates the understanding of deadlines and time limits, ability to accomplish goals, and the desire to win

QUALIFICATIONS:
Education/Experience Required:

  • BS or BA required, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related field; MS or MBA preferred
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in data engineering, data architecture, or business intelligence
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience leading enterprise data platform or data governance programs
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience managing technical teams, including outsourced or offshore resources
  • Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks, or comparable modern data platforms
  • Experience designing semantic models and governing self-service BI environments, preferably Power BI
  • Experience implementing data governance and data protection controls for regulated data such as PHI or PII
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leaders
  • Must have the highest ethical standards and personal integrity

Preferred:

  • Experience operationalizing a Master Data Management program
  • Experience with Microsoft Purview, sensitivity labeling, and data loss prevention
  • Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or healthcare billing system data
  • Experience preparing data platforms for AI, machine learning, or Microsoft Copilot use cases, including Copilot in Fabric and Power BI or Microsoft 365 Copilot
  • Prior experience in medical technology, DME, or other life science or healthcare industries experience supporting SOX controls or validated systems

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Directly supervise team members including but not limited to conducting performance reviews,
    providing feedback, and helping to set professional development goals.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Fast-paced environment
  • Noise level typical of an office environment
  • Kestra manufactures and provides life-saving products regulated by the Federal Food and Drug
  • Administration and under contract with Medicare. Kestra maintains a drug free workplace and testing is a condition of employment.
  • Extended hours when needed

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Frequent repetitive motions that may include wrists, hands and/or fingers, such as keyboard and mouse usage
  • Frequent stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time
  • Occasional phone and other business machine use
  • Occasional lifting required, up to 20 pounds

TRAVEL:

  • Occasional travel, less than 10%

OTHER DUTIES:
This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the Team Member. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

BENEFITS:

Kestra offers a very competitive benefit package including Medical, Dental, 401K with Match, etc.

Pay equity is an important part of Kestra’s Culture. Our compensation ranges are guided by national and local salary surveys and take into consideration experience level and internal equity. Each role is benchmarked based on the job description provided If your qualifications and/or experience level are outside of the posted position, we encourage you to apply as we are growing fast and roles that are coming soon may not be posted.

Salary: Annualized at $185,000 - $215,000 plus bonus, depending on experience. Kestra Medical Technologies is an equal opportunity employer.
